lines.en: : Hey, hey, hey! New games you will play! What do you say?
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 嘿，嘿，嘿！有新游戏给你玩！你觉得怎么样？

lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 咴？¿Qué？你是同性恋吗？

lines.en: : I am not interested in your games, Horseface Taki. You have interrupted my dinner. And for that, you will pay.
lines.zh: : 我对你的游戏没兴趣，马脸 Taki。你打断了我的晚餐。为此，你要付出代价。

lines.en: : You seem to misunderstand your latest kerfuffle, Akira Arakawa. The whole world is watching you right now. Permission to refuse has NOT been granted.
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 你似乎误会了你最近这场骚动的性质，Akira Arakawa。现在全世界都在看着你。你没有被授予拒绝的许可。

lines.en: : Aww man. How come they always have to watch me when I’m naked?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。怎么每次我裸着的时候他们都要看？

lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 你怎么老是裸着？

lines.en: : Probably sex. And also because you guys keep taking my clothes off every time I’ve gotta do one of these thingies.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为性吧。也因为你们每次要我干这种事的时候，都把我的衣服扒了。

lines.en: : Ah! So you know where you are after all?
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 啊！那你终究还是知道自己在哪儿咯？

lines.en: : Another reset right? At least the song is kind of chill this time. I’m straight vibing rn, Horseface Taki.
lines.zh: : 又是重置对吧？至少这次的曲子还挺放松。我现在正沉浸在这氛围里呢，马脸 Taki。

lines.en: I start to do another jig to appease the God of the Track. Soon, I will race with the best.
lines.zh: 我又跳起舞来讨好赛道之神。很快，我就能与最强者一较高下。

lines.en: He jigs along, but only for a few seconds. He clearly has a job to do and I am but his silly little employee.
lines.zh: 他也跟着跳了几秒。他显然有正事要办，而我不过是他手下的小傻瓜员工。

lines.en: : Okay, okay. That’s enough dancing for now. Let me explain the rules of the game.
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 好好好。舞就跳到这儿。我来说明一下游戏规则。

lines.en: : This one’s pretty simple, all things considered.
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 综合考虑下来，这个还挺简单的。

lines.en: : Oh god. That means it’s going to be super complicated, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 哦天。那也就是说它会超级复杂，对吧？

lines.en: : Not at all! In fact, you were already 14.29%% complete before coming here. Just six more pieces and you’re done!
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 一点都不！事实上，你来这儿之前就已经完成 14.29%% 了。再来六块就大功告成！
: 什么的六块？

lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 我正要说呢，行吗？

lines.en: : The goal of this game is to track down the six missing Maya pieces so you can put her back together and continue your journey.
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 这个游戏的目标是找齐 Maya 缺失的六块，好让你把她拼回去，继续你的旅程。

lines.en: : I don’t like this game, Horseface Taki.
lines.zh: : 我不喜欢这个游戏，马脸 Taki。

lines.en: : Not {i}yet{/i} you don’t! But you’ll soon find that this isn’t as complicated as navigating the waiting room or filling out magazine sweepstakes.
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 你只是{i}暂时{/i}不喜欢！不过你很快就会发现，这并不比在候诊室里找路、或者填杂志抽奖券复杂。

lines.en: : In fact, uncovering the missing Maya pieces is as easy as asking your friends if you can have them!
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 事实上，找齐 Maya 缺失的部分简单得很——只要问你的朋友们能不能把它们给你就行！

lines.en: : You brought my friends here? Which ones?
lines.zh: : 你把我的朋友们带到这儿了？哪些？

lines.en: : Well, telling you now would spoil the surprise!
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 嗯，现在告诉你就不惊喜了！

lines.en: : It’s {i}your{/i} job to look around and figure that out yourself. But be warned — some of them might not be willing to part with their fraction of Maya and might ask for something in exchange.
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 四处看看、自己弄清楚，那是{i}你{/i}的活儿。不过要提醒你——有些人可能不愿意割舍她们那份 Maya，可能会要求你拿东西来换。

lines.en: : Sounds simple enough. I’m used to transactions like this. I’ve lost count of how many times I’ve traded my wiener for warmth and affection.
lines.zh: : 听起来够简单。我习惯这种交易了。我都数不清自己拿老二换温暖和爱意换了多少回。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, you can’t trade your body in this game. You need to trade items instead. And each friend will have specific preferences you’ll need to match.
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，这游戏里不能拿身体交易。你得用物品来换。而且每个朋友都有特定的偏好，你得对上。

lines.en: : Just obtaining these items would be too easy, though. You’ll need to assemble them yourself. But hey, that’ll be good practice for when you have to reassemble Maya.
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 不过光是拿到这些东西也太容易了。你得自己把它们制作出来。不过话说回来，这对你之后拼装 Maya 也是个不错的练习。

lines.en: : What happens when I do that? Is the game over?
lines.zh: : 我拼好之后会怎样？游戏就结束了吗？

lines.en: : Once Maya is reassembled, the portal back to your world will be opened. But you’re also free to keep hanging out here if you want. And who knows? Maybe you’ll find something else too!
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 一旦 Maya 被拼好，回到你那个世界的传送门就会打开。不过你想继续在这儿晃也随你。而且谁知道呢？说不定你还能发现别的东西！

lines.en: : Something else? Like what? Extra body parts for Maya? Because I kind of like her a lot the way she is now.
lines.zh: : 别的东西？比如什么？给 Maya 的额外身体部件？因为我其实挺喜欢她现在这样的。

lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 一颗被砍下的头？

lines.en: : Huh? Oh. No. I meant when all of her pieces are put together. I kind of forgot she was just a head now.
lines.zh: : 哈？哦。不是。我是说等她所有部件都拼好之后。我有点忘了她现在只是一颗头。

lines.en: : Unfortunately, I can’t tell you what you’ll find out there. But I {i}can{/i} tell you you won’t find anything by just standing around and talking to me!
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，我不能告诉你在外面会发现什么。但我{i}能{/i}告诉你——光是站在这儿跟我说话，你什么也找不到！

lines.en: : Venture out and test your knowledge once more! And remember — the whole world is watching. You wouldn’t want to leave a bad impression, would you?
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 出去闯荡，再考一次你的知识储备吧！记住——全世界都在看着。你不会想留下坏印象的，对吧？

lines.en: : Of course not. Thank you, Horseface Taki. You are easily the most helpful god I have encountered thus far.
lines.zh: : 当然不想。谢谢你，马脸 Taki。你到目前为止绝对是我遇到过最乐于助人的神。

lines.en: : Right now, I am just a Lesser God. I must guide at least eighty-five more people through these events until I am eligible for promotion.
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 现在我还只是个下位神。我得再引导至少八十五个人走完这些流程，才有资格晋升。

lines.en: : Well, get ready. Because it’s {i}about{/i} to be eighty-four.
lines.zh: : 那准备好吧。因为马上就要变成八十四了。

lines.en: : I think you might be greatly overestimating the frequency at which these are actually completed.
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 我觉得你可能严重高估了这些流程实际被完成的频率。

lines.en: : Doesn’t matter. The fact remains that it’s time to go collect the pieces of my girlfriend’s corpse and carry her back to my world!
lines.zh: : 不重要。事实是，是时候去收集我女朋友尸体的碎片，把她带回我的世界了！

lines.en: I carefully place the corpseflower seed into the soil and drizzle a little water onto it.
lines.zh: 我小心地把尸花种子放进土里，再洒上一点水。

lines.en: I carefully remove the corpseflower from the soil and shove it into my pocket.
lines.zh: 我小心地把尸花从土里拔出来，塞进兜里。

lines.en: It’s way too big for it and it smells kind of bad, but what else am I going to do about it?
lines.zh: 它对我的兜来说太大了，而且闻起来有点臭，可我还能怎么办呢？

lines.en: I carefully remove the lavender from the soil and shove it into my pocket.
lines.zh: 我小心地把薰衣草从土里拔出来，塞进兜里。

lines.en: I hear a whisper from the attic but decide it’s just another ghost and ignore it.
lines.zh: 我听见阁楼里传来低语，但断定那不过是又一个幽灵，便没去理会。

lines.en: I carefully place the poppy seeds into the soil and drizzle a little water onto them.
lines.zh: 我小心地把罂粟种子放进土里，再洒上一点水。

lines.en: I carefully remove the poppies from the soil and shove them into my pocket.
lines.zh: 我小心地把罂粟从土里拔出来，塞进兜里。

lines.en: I hope this doesn’t get me high.
lines.zh: 我希望这不会让我上头。

lines.en: I carefully place the rose seeds into the soil and drizzle a little water onto them.
lines.zh: 我小心地把玫瑰种子放进土里，再洒上一点水。

lines.en: I carefully remove the roses from the soil and shove them into my pocket.
lines.zh: 我小心地把玫瑰从土里拔出来，塞进兜里。

lines.en: The thorns dig into my thigh and cause me to bleed. Is this the price of love?
lines.zh: 荆棘扎进我的大腿，把我扎出血了。这就是爱的代价吗？

lines.en: I carefully place the snapdragon seeds into the soil and drizzle a little water onto them.

lines.zh: 我小心地把金鱼草从土里拔出来，塞进兜里。

lines.en: I can feel myself getting stronger. Do I have superpowers now?
lines.zh: 我感觉自己变强了。我现在有超能力了吗？
返回

lines.en: I bend some sticks into a circle and peel off pieces of the corpseflower to wrap around it.
lines.zh: 我把几根树枝弯成一个圈，剥下几片尸花缠在上面。

lines.en: I figure this might make a good accessory for one’s head.
lines.zh: 我觉得这也许是个不错的头上配饰。
{i}你获得了{b}尸冠{/b}！{/i}
: 太他妈棒了。
玫瑰花束

lines.en: I tear the flowery parts off of the flowers off and place them onto new stick-based stems that won’t decay over time.
lines.zh: 我把花的花瓣部分扯下来，装到用树枝做成、不会随时间腐烂的新花茎上。
这样应该行得通吧？
{i}你获得了{b}玫瑰花束{/b}！{/i}
: 太他妈棒了。
薰衣草香水

lines.en: Using some of the sticks Makoto gave me as a makeshift pestle, I grind the lavender into a fine paste and empty it into a jar I found in Ami’s room.
lines.zh: 我用 Makoto 给我的几根树枝当临时杵，把薰衣草磨成细糊，倒进我在 Ami 房间里找到的一个罐子里。

lines.en: Whatever was inside the jar mixes with the lavender quite well. And before I know it, I have perfume.
lines.zh: 罐子里原来装的东西和薰衣草混合得相当好。不知不觉，我就有了香水。
{i}你获得了{b}薰衣草香水{/b}！{/i}
: 太他妈棒了。
金鱼草手链

lines.en: I bend some sticks into tiny circles and braid them around each other before plucking petals from the snapdragons and adhering them to said circles with glue.
lines.zh: 我把几根树枝弯成小圈，互相编织在一起，再从金鱼草上摘下花瓣，用胶水粘到那些圈上。

lines.en: Horseface Taki looks on in anguish for some reason. I don’t get it.
lines.zh: 马脸 Taki 不知为何痛苦地看着。我不明白为什么。
{i}你获得了{b}金鱼草手链{/b}！{/i}
: 太他妈棒了。
鸦片

lines.en: I extract opium from the poppy latex and prepare it for distribution.
lines.zh: 我从罂粟乳汁里提取出鸦片，准备好分发。
不知道怎么还用上了树枝。
{i}你获得了{b}鸦片{/b}！{/i}
: 太他妈棒了。
究极树枝花束

lines.en: When I think to myself about what Makoto likes, there is only one thing that comes to mind.
lines.zh: 我琢磨 Makoto 喜欢什么时，脑海里只浮现出一样东西。
树枝。

lines.en: She has so many of them lately and has never explained why.
lines.zh: 她最近有好多树枝，却从来没解释过为什么。

lines.en: What this means is that I should make her an ultimate bouquet consisting entirely of sticks in order to show my gratitude for her help.
lines.zh: 这意味着我该给她做一束全由树枝组成的究极花束，以感谢她的帮助。
我照做了。
{i}你获得了{b}究极树枝花束{/b}！{/i}
: 我来了，Makoto。

lines.en: I make my way over to the bed and lay out a sheet of cardboard so the Maya pieces don’t cross-contaminate the place I sleep.
lines.zh: 我走到床边，铺上一张硬纸板，免得 Maya 的碎片交叉污染我睡觉的地方。

lines.en: : I’ll tell you what. Take these. It’s not a piece of your girlfriend, but you {i}should{/i} be able to find some sort of use for them.
lines.zh: : 这样吧。这些给你。虽然不是你女朋友的一块，但你{i}应该{/i}能派上点用场。
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}罂粟种子{/b}！{/i}

lines.en: : Do I look like a bagel to you?
lines.zh: : 我看起来像百吉饼吗？

lines.en: : Of course not! But it’s not like I have anything {i}else{/i} to give you. Well, apart from that piece of Maya. Like, I don’t even have clothes anymore.
lines.zh: : 当然不像！可我也没{i}别的{/i}东西可以给你了呀。除了那块 Maya。我连衣服都没有了。

lines.en: : Ugh...fine. I’ll take your stupid poppy seeds.
lines.zh: : 呃……行吧。我就收下你那破罂粟种子。

lines.en: : But when I come back, you better be willing to do business.
lines.zh: : 不过等我回来的时候，你最好愿意跟我做生意。

lines.en: : Maybe! We’ll have to just wait and see.
lines.zh: : 也许吧！那就等着瞧了。
: 再见，哥哥！快点回来哦！

lines.en: : Oh! And avoid the third classroom on the left! There’s a strange entity in there you can’t find out about yet!
lines.zh: : 哦！还有，避开左边第三间教室！里面有个你暂时还不能知道是什么的奇怪东西！

lines.en: I heed Noriko’s warning, having already met too many strange entities, and head back outside to regroup.
lines.zh: 我已经见过了太多奇怪的东西，于是听从 Noriko 的警告，回到外面重整旗鼓。
我现在该去哪儿？
提出交易

lines.en: : I’d like to propose a trade.
lines.zh: : 我想提议一笔交易。

lines.en: : Sure! What do you have in mind?
lines.zh: : 好啊！你有什么想法？
回到外面

lines.en: : Actually, on second thought, I’m just going to go home. I don’t think I have anything you want.
lines.zh: : 其实，想想还是算了，我直接回家好了。我觉得我这儿没有你想要的东西。
: 哎呀。没关系啦！

lines.en: : I’ll be here whenever you come back. Just make sure to call my name since I might be busy sloshing around.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候回来我都在这儿。只要记得喊我名字就行，因为我可能正忙着哗啦水呢。
: 听起来不错。回头见，Noriko。
: 再见，哥哥！

lines.en: I head back outside to gather my thoughts and figure something else out.
lines.zh: 我回到外面，整理思绪，想着还能搞出点什么名堂。
尸冠

lines.en: : This cool crown I made out of a corpseflower for your Maya piece. What do you say?
lines.zh: : 这顶用尸花给你做的超酷冠冕，换你那块 Maya。你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: : {i}Sniff, sniff.{/i} Why does it smell so weird?
lines.zh: : {i}嗅，嗅。{/i}它怎么闻起来这么奇怪？

lines.en: : I think it’s just a corpseflower thing.
lines.zh: : 我觉得尸花就是这个味儿。

lines.en: : And you want me to wear that on my head?
lines.zh: : 而你想让我把它戴在头上？

lines.en: : No. {i}You{/i} want to wear it on your head. And then give me a piece of Maya in exchange for it.
lines.zh: : 不。是{i}你{/i}想把它戴在头上。然后给我一块 Maya 作为交换。

lines.en: : Mmm...I don’t think so, Onii-chan. Sorry!
lines.zh: : 嗯……我看还是算了，哥哥。抱歉！
: 该死。
薰衣草香水

lines.en: : Some perfume made out of lavender and mystery liquid for your Maya piece. What do you say?
lines.zh: : 用薰衣草和某种神秘液体调的香水，换你那块 Maya。你觉得怎么样？
: 神秘液体？

lines.en: : I found it in some jar Ami was holding onto.
lines.zh: : 是我在 Ami 一直攥着的某个罐子里找到的。
: 我能闻闻吗？
: 当然。

lines.en: I give her a quick spritz with the tester bottle of perfume I made as well, knowing that someone was bound to ask me for this.
lines.zh: 既然知道总会有人问我要这个，我也顺手拿自己做的小样瓶给她喷了一下。

lines.en: : Ohhhh, I know what this is.
lines.zh: : 噢噢噢，我知道这是什么了。
: 你能告诉我吗？
: 我……大概不该说。抱歉，哥哥！

lines.en: : I {i}do{/i} love it, but I think I’m looking for something else right now. Have any other offers?
lines.zh: : 我{i}确实{/i}喜欢它，不过我觉得我现在在找别的东西。还有别的提议吗？
: 呃。该死。
鸦片

lines.en: : How about some opium? That should net me a piece of Maya, right?
lines.zh: : 来点鸦片怎么样？这总能给我换来一块 Maya 吧？

lines.en: : Opium? Don’t tell me that’s what you turned my poppy seeds into?
lines.zh: : 鸦片？你该不会是把我的罂粟种子做成了这个吧？

lines.en: : Sure. I won’t tell you anything. Do we have a deal?
lines.zh: : 当然。我什么都不会说的。成交吗？

lines.en: : Onii-chan! I don’t want you to become a drug dealer! You’re supposed to be a good boy!
lines.zh: : 哥哥！我不想让你变成毒贩！你本来应该是个好男孩的！

lines.en: : You have pushed me to this, Noriko. {i}I{/i} didn’t want to be a drug dealer either.
lines.zh: : 是你把我逼到这一步的，Noriko。{i}我{/i}也不想当毒贩啊。

lines.en: : Then quit! And make me a {i}new{/i} offer. I don’t want any opium.
lines.zh: : 那就别干了！再给我{i}重新{/i}提个建议。我不要鸦片。
: 呃。你有时候真难搞。
玫瑰花束

lines.en: : Would a nice bouquet of roses be enough to get that Maya piece off of your hands?
lines.zh: : 一束漂亮的玫瑰，够不够让你把那块 Maya 让出来？

lines.en: : You just bought that from the gas station, didn’t you?
lines.zh: : 你刚从加油站买的吧？

lines.en: : No! I grew the roses myself with some seeds I got from Chika. Then replaced all of the stems with some sticks I got from Makoto.
lines.zh: : 不是！玫瑰是我自己用 Chika 给的种子种的。然后又把我从 Makoto 那儿拿来的树枝全换成了花茎。

lines.en: : That bouquet’s really gotten around then, huh?
lines.zh: : 那这束花还真是转了好几手啊？
: 嗯……算是吧。不过-

lines.en: : Sorry, Onii-chan. I don’t want to think of Chika or Makoto every time I look at them. Do you have any other ideas?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，哥哥。我可不想每次看到它们就想起 Chika 或 Makoto。你还有别的主意吗？
: 呃……让我想想。
金鱼草手链

lines.en: : How about this cool bracelet I made out of sticks and snapdragons?
lines.zh: : 那这条用树枝和金鱼草做的超酷手链怎么样？

lines.en: : Oooh! Let me see, let me see!
lines.zh: : 噢噢！让我看看，让我看看！

lines.en: I hand Noriko the bracelet and she begins to inspect it. I think her eyes widen as well, but they’re currently censored and I can’t really tell.
lines.zh: 我把手链递给 Noriko，她开始端详起来。我觉得她的眼睛也睁大了，不过它们现在被打码了，我也看不太出来。
嘿，酷。这句押韵了。

lines.en: : You made this yourself, Onii-chan? It’s really good!
lines.zh: : 这是你自己做的吗，哥哥？做得真好！

lines.en: : They say snapdragons symbolize strength and grace. And no girl encompasses those traits better than you do, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 据说金鱼草象征着力量与优雅。而没有哪个女孩比你更能体现这两种特质了，Noriko。

lines.en: : Aww! That’s so sweet! I love it.
lines.zh: : 哇！太贴心了！我喜欢。

lines.en: : Plus, I kind of miss wearing accessories. Being naked all the time is a little boring.
lines.zh: : 而且我也有点想念戴配饰了。一直光着身子有点无聊。
: 那我们……成交了？
: 成交！
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的躯干{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的骨盆{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左腿{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右腿{b}!{/i}

lines.en: : Hell yeah. I’m so good at commerce.
lines.zh: : 太他妈爽了。我做生意真有一套。

lines.en: : I’m kind of sad that you’re going to leave me again. But hey, at least I get a bracelet out of it this time. That’s more than Nee-chan can say.
lines.zh: : 你又要丢下我了，我有点难过。不过嘿，至少这次我捞到了一条手链。这点连姐姐都说不上。

lines.en: : Are you just gonna hang out here? Or do you want to come back to my place and help me rebuild Maya?
lines.zh: : 你就打算一直待在这儿？还是想跟我回我那儿，帮我一起重建 Maya？

lines.en: : I’ll stay here for now. Maybe we’ll meet again on the outside, though? If I ever decide to leave, that is.
lines.zh: : 我暂时留在这儿吧。不过也许我们会在外面再见？如果哪天我决定离开的话。

lines.en: : I hope you do, Noriko. Take care, okay?
lines.zh: : 我希望你会，Noriko。照顾好自己，好吗？

lines.en: : You too, Onii-chan! Good luck with your crafts and stuff!
lines.zh: : 你也是，哥哥！祝你做手工什么的都顺利！

lines.en: I leave Noriko and head back outside to figure out where to go from here.
lines.zh: 我离开 Noriko，回到外面想接下来该去哪儿。
回到外面

lines.en: : Actually, on second thought, I’m just going to go home. I don’t think I have anything you want.
lines.zh: : 其实，想想还是算了，我直接回家好了。我觉得我这儿没有你想要的东西。
: 哎呀。没关系啦！

lines.en: : I’ll be here whenever you come back. Just make sure to call my name since I might be busy sloshing around.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候回来我都在这儿。只要记得喊我名字就行，因为我可能正忙着哗啦水呢。
: 听起来不错。回头见，Noriko。
: 再见，哥哥！

lines.en: I head back outside to gather my thoughts and figure something else out.
lines.zh: 我回到外面，整理思绪，想着还能搞出点什么名堂。

lines.en: : Futaba? Are you there? I want to talk to you again.
lines.zh: : Futaba？你在吗？我想再和你聊聊。

lines.en: : Welcome back, Sensei. I’ve been waiting for you.
lines.zh: : 欢迎回来，Sensei。我一直在等你。
: 你需要什么吗？

lines.en: I suddenly find myself in a peculiar restaurant.
lines.zh: 我突然发现自己身处一家奇特的餐厅。

lines.en: After waiting in a relatively long queue behind a number of elongated specters, I’m taken into the dining room to meet my server.
lines.zh: 在一群被拉长的幽灵后面排了相当久的队之后，我被领进餐厅去见我的服务员。

lines.en: And while the room {i}may{/i} look to the untrained eye like a library flipped on its head, the reality is that this is the best eatery in town.
lines.zh: 虽然在没见过世面的人眼里，这间屋子{i}大概{/i}像一间被倒过来的图书馆，但事实是，这是全城最好的馆子。

lines.en: Or at least it used to be. Lately, it’s been occupied by ghosts who can’t let go of the past. And this is where they come to pretend they haven’t grown up.
lines.zh: 至少以前是。最近它被一群放不下过去的幽灵占据了。他们来这儿，是为了假装自己还没长大。

lines.en: : W-Welcome to the Cartographer’s Crab-Shack! I’m your server, Fu- Sensei?
lines.zh: : 欢-欢迎光临制图师的小蟹屋！我是您的服务员，Fu——Sensei？

lines.en: : Nice to meet you, Fu-Sensei. One cajun seafood boil, please. And for the drink, I’ll just have a water.
lines.zh: : 很高兴认识你，Fu-Sensei。来一份卡真海鲜大杂烩。饮料的话，给我杯水就行。
: Sensei，别这样。是我啊，Futaba。

lines.en: : Oh, wow. It is. Sorry, I was just so entranced by the menu. There are so many options here.
lines.zh: : 哦，哇。真的是你。抱歉，我光顾着看菜单了。这儿的选择太多了。

lines.en: : Only because we’re serving up anything you can imagine.
lines.zh: : 那是因为我们这儿什么都做，只要你想得出来。

lines.en: : Really? In that case, can I also have a side of one of Maya’s body parts?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？那我能再点一份 Maya 的身体部件当配菜吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...I guess I probably shouldn’t have said {i}anything{/i} you can imagine, huh?
lines.zh: : 呃……看来我大概不该说{i}什么{/i}都想得出来，是吧？

lines.en: : Are you telling me I need to summon the manager?
lines.zh: : 你是要我把经理叫来吗？
: 我……其实{i}就是{/i}经理。

lines.en: : Woah, really? Congratulations. How’d that happen? You’re such a normal girl back home.
lines.zh: : 喔，真的吗？恭喜。这是怎么做到的？你在我们那个世界里就是个普通高中女生啊。

lines.en: : Well, to me, this {i}is{/i} my home. I grew up in the corner right behind me. And while it took me a long time to come out of my shell, pun intended, I’m...doing kind of great now.
lines.zh: : 嗯，对我来说，这儿{i}就{/i}是我的家。我是在我身后那个角落里长大的。虽然我花了很长时间才从壳里走出来——双关语，我承认——但我现在……过得还挺不错的。

lines.en: : So you don’t want to come back to our world? You want to stay here and serve imaginary crab to elongated specters?
lines.zh: : 所以你不想回我们的世界了？你想留在这儿，给那些被拉长的幽灵上端上想象出来的螃蟹？

lines.en: : There will always be a me somewhere else. And all of our memories are connected, so it’s kind of like I’m everywhere at once.
lines.zh: : 在别的地方总会有一个我。而我们所有的记忆都是相连的，所以某种程度上，我就像同时存在于各处。

lines.en: : Weird. I wonder if it’s the same for all of the other girls?
lines.zh: : 真怪。不知道其他女孩是不是也一样？

lines.en: : Probably. It’s been a long time since I’ve seen any of them, though.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。不过我已经很久没见过她们中的任何一个了。

lines.en: : Ever since the remainders of Maya were scattered across the land, we’ve all sort of lost touch.
lines.zh: : 自从 Maya 的残骸散落在这片土地上的各个角落，我们就都慢慢断了联系。

lines.en: : Wait. Are you saying that a piece of her {i}can{/i} be found here after all?
lines.zh: : 等等。你是说这里{i}确实{/i}能找到她的一块？

lines.en: : Oh, yes. You just can’t order it like an appetizer. {i}These{/i} are your appetizers.
lines.zh: : 哦，是的。只是你不能把它当开胃菜点就是了。{i}这些{/i}才是你的开胃菜。
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}薰衣草种子{/b}！{/i}
: 薰衣草种子？

lines.en: : Wow, Sensei. Your seed identification skills are very impressive. Only an expert could decipher what type of seeds those are just by looking at them.
lines.zh: : 哇，Sensei。你辨认种子的能力真了不起。只有行家才能光看一眼就判断出那是什么种子。
: 我该把它们吃了？

lines.en: : Or hold on to them, if you’d prefer. They might even grow into something else if you care for them enough.
lines.zh: : 或者，如果你更愿意的话，先留着。只要好好照料，它们说不定还能长成别的东西。
: 薰衣草吧，我猜。
: 这么说也合理，嗯。

lines.en: : How do I get the piece of Maya then?
lines.zh: : 那我要怎么拿到 Maya 的那一块？

lines.en: : Well, imaginary or not, this is still a business. Which means there will be some sort of transaction involved.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不管是真是假，这里终究是门生意。也就是说，总归要涉及某种交易。

lines.en: : The only issue is I have very specific tastes and not just any old item will suffice. I’m sure you’ll figure out what I want in no time at all, though.
lines.zh: : 唯一的麻烦是，我的口味非常挑剔，不是随便什么旧东西都能打发。不过我相信你很快就能摸清我想要什么。

lines.en: : I hope so. That Maya back home isn’t going to build itself. Can I just come back whenever I want then?
lines.zh: : 希望如此。家里那个 Maya 可不会自己拼好。那我能随时回来找你吗？

lines.en: : Mhm. Just call out for me once you do. This isn’t a real restaurant, so you aren’t going to disturb any customers.
lines.zh: : 嗯。回来的时候喊我一声就行。这不是真正的餐厅，所以你不会打扰到任何客人。

lines.en: : Oh, and if you see other girls that look just like me around here, they’re also me. You can sleep with all of them and I won’t get upset.
lines.zh: : 哦，还有，如果你在这儿看到别的长得跟我一样的女孩，那也都是我。你可以和她们所有人上床，我不会生气的。

lines.en: : Sorry. No sex for me in here, Futaba. I’ve got a job to do.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我在这儿不做爱，Futaba。我有正事要办。

lines.en: : In fact, I should probably get back to that now if you’re not going to just hand over your fragment of Maya.
lines.zh: : 事实上，如果你不打算直接把你那块 Maya 交出来，我大概也该回去办正事了。

lines.en: : Okay! It was nice seeing you, though. Feel free to come back whenever you’re ready to do business. And remember-
lines.zh: : 好的！不过见到你很高兴。想做买卖的时候随时回来。还有，记住——
: 无限的 Futaba 性爱。我知道。

lines.en: : Oh, no. I was talking about the “calling out to me” part.
lines.zh: : 哦，不是。我说的是“喊我名字”那部分。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah. I’ll remember that too. Later, Futaba.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。那个我也会记住的。回头见，Futaba。
: 再见，Sensei！
: 后会有期……

lines.en: I pay my imaginary bill and exit the Cartographer’s Crab-Shack.
lines.zh: 我付了那张想象出来的账单，走出了制图师的小蟹屋。

lines.en: What do I want to do now?
lines.zh: 我现在想做点什么？
提出交易

lines.en: : I’d like to propose a trade.
lines.zh: : 我想提议一笔交易。

lines.en: : Sure. What do you have in mind?
lines.zh: : 好啊。你有什么想法？
回到外面

lines.en: : On second thought, I don’t think I have anything you’d want. I’ll come back later, once I do.
lines.zh: : 想想还是算了，我觉得我这儿没有你想要的东西。等有了我再回来。

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll be here. Bye, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 好的。我会在这儿。再见，Sensei。
: 回头见，Fu-Sensei。

lines.en: : Can you...please stop calling me that?
lines.zh: : 你能……别这么叫我吗？

lines.en: I head back outside to gather my thoughts and figure something else out.
lines.zh: 我回到外面，整理思绪，想着还能搞出点什么名堂。
尸冠

lines.en: : So I made this crown of corpseflowers that I think would look great on you.
lines.zh: : 我做了这顶尸花冠，我觉得你戴上会很好看。

lines.en: : Oooh...yeah, I don’t think I should wear that. One of the specters told me some pretty bad rumors about those things.
lines.zh: : 噢噢……嗯，我觉得我不该戴那个。有个幽灵跟我说了些关于那玩意的相当糟糕的传闻。

lines.en: : Probably so he can make his own off-brand versions and peddle them to your coworkers. This one here’s the real deal, Futaba. This thing smells like so many corpses.
lines.zh: : 那大概是为了好自己做一些山寨版，再拿去卖给你的同事。我手上这顶可是正品，Futaba。这东西闻起来像无数具尸体。

lines.en: : Yeah, see, that’s another reason I don’t really want it.
lines.zh: : 是吧，你看，这正是我不想戴它的另一个原因。
: 你还有别的吗？
: 呃……让我想想。
薰衣草香水

lines.en: : How about this lavender perfume I made out of the seeds you gave me?
lines.zh: : 用你给我的种子做的这款薰衣草香水怎么样？

lines.en: : I already have some lavender-scented perfume, but maybe yours is nicer? Can you tell me what’s in it?
lines.zh: : 我已经有一瓶薰衣草味香水了，不过也许你的更好闻？你能告诉我里面有什么吗？
: 具体说？还是笼统说？

lines.en: : Well...{i}you{/i} made it, didn’t you? So whatever you put it into it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……{i}你{/i}做的吧？那不就是你往里面加了什么。
: 薰衣草。
: 还有呢？

lines.en: : Some mystery fluid from a jar in Ami’s room.
lines.zh: : Ami 房间里一个罐子里的某种神秘液体。
: 很酷吧？

lines.en: : I think I’m good on perfume right now, actually.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我现在香水够用了，真的。

lines.en: : Damn it. What else do I have?
lines.zh: : 该死。我还有什么来着？
鸦片

lines.en: : You look like the kind of girl who likes to have a good time. How about some opium to {i}really{/i} get this party started?
lines.zh: : 你看起来像那种喜欢找乐子的女孩。来点鸦片，{i}真正{/i}把场子热起来怎么样？

lines.en: : Your personality has taken a pretty dark shift since Maya was decapitated, huh?
lines.zh: : 自从 Maya 被斩首之后，你的性格转变挺阴暗的啊？

lines.en: : I’m just trying to get by, Futaba. And sometimes, {i}getting by{/i} means selling opium in exchange for body parts. You know the hustle, right?
lines.zh: : 我只是在想办法过日子，Futaba。而有时候，{i}过日子{/i}就意味着卖鸦片换身体部件。你懂这行的门道吧？

lines.en: : Like, the dance? I don’t think I’m old enough to-
lines.zh: : 门道？是指那种舞吗？我觉得我还没到年纪——

lines.en: : No, like the {i}hustle.{/i} The struggle. What people like me have to do to get by.
lines.zh: : 不是，是{i}门道{/i}。挣扎。像我这样的人为了活下去不得不做的事。

lines.en: : Yeah, no. I don’t know that. And I don’t really want any drugs either, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯，不懂。这个我真不懂。而且我也不想要什么毒品，所以……

lines.en: : Tch. Fine. Let’s see what else I have.
lines.zh: : 啧。行吧。看看我还剩什么。
玫瑰花束

lines.en: : I think you’d really like this, Futaba. Look.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你肯定会喜欢的，Futaba。你看。

lines.en: I give Futaba the bouquet of roses, which she grabs with both hands and subsequently cuts her palms on thanks to the artificial, stick-based thorns I included.
lines.zh: 我把那束玫瑰递给 Futaba，她双手接过去，结果被我加进去的人造树枝刺扎破了手掌。

lines.en: The blood drips down her wrists like ice cream off a melting cone, connecting with the floor similarly to the way in which melted ice cream would connect with the same floor if it also did that.
lines.zh: 血顺着她的手腕往下淌，像融化中的甜筒上滴落的冰淇淋，以融化的冰淇淋若是也这样做的话会接触地板的那种方式，与地板连接在了一起。

lines.en: : They’re beautiful...where did you get this?
lines.zh: : 它们好美……你从哪儿弄来的？

lines.en: : I grew them myself with some seeds Chika gave me.
lines.zh: : 我用 Chika 给我的种子自己种的。

lines.en: : And you’re...giving the bouquet to me instead of Chika? Why?
lines.zh: : 而你……要把这束花给我而不是 Chika？为什么？

lines.en: : Well, roses are a symbol of love or something, aren’t they?
lines.zh: : 嗯，玫瑰不是爱情的象征之类的吗？

lines.en: : I repeat — why are you giving this to {i}me{/i} instead of Chika? Or...literally anyone else. You don’t {i}love{/i} me.
lines.zh: : 我再说一遍——你为什么要把它给{i}我{/i}而不是 Chika？或者……别的任何人。你并不{i}爱{/i}我。

lines.en: : But I will one day. And until then, these roses will serve as a symbol of that.
lines.zh: : 但总有一天我会的。在那之前，这些玫瑰就当作是那个的象征。

lines.en: : Plus, I replaced the stems with sticks, so they’ll live forever and you won’t need to water them.
lines.zh: : 而且我把花茎换成了树枝，所以它们永远不会凋谢，你也不用浇水。

lines.en: : Does it really work like that?
lines.zh: : 真能这样吗？
: 我不知道。也许吧？

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}I still don’t think I’m deserving of this, but...I {i}do{/i} like them. And...I know you really want to put Maya back together, so...
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}我还是觉得自己配不上这个，不过……我{i}确实{/i}很喜欢它们。而且……我知道你真的很想把 Maya 拼回去，所以……
: 给你。
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的躯干{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的骨盆{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左腿{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右腿{b}!{/i}

lines.en: : Now you’re one piece closer to having a whole girl.
lines.zh: : 现在你离拥有一个完整的女孩又近了一块。

lines.en: : I sure am. Thanks a lot, Futaba. I’m glad to have you as my business partner.
lines.zh: : 是啊。多谢了，Futaba。很高兴有你这么个生意伙伴。

lines.en: : You have me as much more than that, Sensei. Or...at least you {i}could{/i} if you only wanted to.
lines.zh: : 你拥有的我可远不止是生意伙伴，Sensei。或者……只要你愿意，你{i}本来{/i}可以拥有更多。

lines.en: : Good to know. Later, then. I have to go  assemble a teenager.
lines.zh: : 知道了。那回头见。我还得去组装一个少女。
: {i}哈……{/i}再见，Sensei。

lines.en: : Thanks again for coming to the Cartographer’s Crab-Shack.
lines.zh: : 再次感谢你光临制图师的小蟹屋。

lines.en: I leave Futaba and head back outside to figure out where to go from here.
lines.zh: 我离开 Futaba，回到外面想接下来该去哪儿。
金鱼草手链

lines.en: : How about this nice little bracelet I made out of snapdragons?
lines.zh: : 那这条我用金鱼草做的小手链怎么样？
: 我对金鱼草过敏。
: 什么？这也有可能吗？

lines.en: : Well, I don’t know if it’s technically {i}allergies,{/i} but I start to panic whenever I’m near them.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我不知道这在技术上算不算{i}过敏{/i}，不过我一靠近它们就会开始恐慌。

lines.en: : What if I just try to put it on your wrist like-
lines.zh: : 要是我直接试着把它戴到你手腕上，就像——
: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊——
: 哦，好吧。当我没说。

lines.en: : Sorry. Do you have anything else?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。你还有别的吗？
: 呃……让我想想。
回到外面

lines.en: : On second thought, I don’t think I have anything you’d want. I’ll come back later, once I do.
lines.zh: : 想想还是算了，我觉得我这儿没有你想要的东西。等有了我再回来。

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll be here. Bye, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 好的。我会在这儿。再见，Sensei。
: 回头见，Fu-Sensei。

lines.en: : Can you...please stop calling me that?
lines.zh: : 你能……别这么叫我吗？

lines.en: I head back outside to gather my thoughts and figure something else out.
lines.zh: 我回到外面，整理思绪，想着还能搞出点什么名堂。

lines.en: : Sana? Are you there? I want to talk to you again.
lines.zh: : Sana？你在吗？我想再和你聊聊。
: 嗯……欢迎回来，Sensei……
: 你……需要什么吗？

lines.en: I arrive at a beach that could use some bleach, but I won’t let that deter me from having a good time.
lines.zh: 我来到一片真该漂白一下的海滩，不过我不会因此扫了玩的兴致。

lines.en: I just don’t like the fact that I can {i}tell{/i} the time at all as places like this are meant to be an escape from that.
lines.zh: 我只是不太喜欢自己居然能{i}看{/i}出时间——这种地方本该是让人逃离时间的。

lines.en: Yet a clock hangs high upon a wall painted to resemble the sky, towering precariously over my desire for leisure and an even more hidden desire to drown myself in the ocean.
lines.zh: 然而一面钟高高挂在被漆成天空模样的墙上，摇摇欲坠地悬在我对闲适的渴望、以及那份更隐秘的想把自己淹死在海里的渴望之上。

lines.en: At least then I’d be able to escape the humidity from the world’s largest indoor pool.
lines.zh: 至少那样我就能躲开这个世界上最大的室内泳池的湿气了。

lines.en: : Oh. Sana. I didn’t expect to see you here. You don’t seem like much of a beach person.
lines.zh: : 哦。Sana。没想到会在这儿见到你。你看起来不像会来海滩的人。

lines.en: : One could say the same for you, Sensei...but the truth is I’ve already met you here once before.
lines.zh: : 这话用在 Sensei 你身上也一样……不过说实话，我已经在这儿见过你一次了。
: 什么？什么时候？

lines.en: : You were younger...I was not...and you rejected my advances, but...
lines.zh: : 那时你更年轻……我没有……而你拒绝了我的示好，不过……

lines.en: : You won’t do that anymore, will you?...
lines.zh: : 你现在不会再那样了，对吧？……

lines.en: : Because my brother is here too and I think it’d be really hot if you guys, like...restrained me and filled both of my holes at the same time.
lines.zh: : 因为我哥哥也在这儿，我觉得要是你们俩，就是……把我按住，同时填满我两个洞，那该有多带劲。

lines.en: : That’s not really what I had in mind when coming here. I’m glad to hear he’s doing okay, though.
lines.zh: : 我来这儿可不是为了这个。不过听到他还安好我很高兴。

lines.en: : He doesn’t move anymore, but it seems like bodies don’t really decay in here. I think it must be due to the humidity.
lines.zh: : 他已经不动了，不过看起来尸体在这儿不太会腐烂。我想大概是湿气的关系。

lines.en: : Ahh, so you were just going to make me do all of the restraining myself while you humped your brother’s corpse.
lines.zh: : 啊，所以你是打算让我一个人负责按住你，而你骑着你哥哥的尸体磨。

lines.en: : And you. You’d get a turn too. Don’t make me out to be weird because of that, though. You’re doing the same thing by trying to reassemble Maya, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 还有你。也会轮到你的。不过别因为这个就把我说成怪人。你想把 Maya 拼回去，不也是在干同样的事吗？

lines.en: : I’m reassembling Maya so I can bring her back home. Not so I can have sex with her.
lines.zh: : 我拼 Maya 是为了把她带回家。不是为了和她上床。
: 我是{i}认真的{/i}，Sana。
: Sana。

lines.en: : I get it, Sensei. You’re only going to use her body for {i}wholesome{/i} purposes. I {i}completely{/i} understand.
lines.zh: : 我懂，Sensei。你只会把她的身体用在{i}正当{/i}的用途上。我{i}完全{/i}理解。

lines.en: : Stop winking at me. I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 别对我眨眼睛。我不喜欢。

lines.en: : Sorry...it’s just been a while since I’ve seen anything move...
lines.zh: : 抱歉……只是太久没见过会动的东西了……

lines.en: : Even the water is completely still. And the hands on the clock are stuck, so...I sort of just wander around and look for things to hump...
lines.zh: : 连水都完全静止。而且钟上的指针也卡住了，所以我……就那么四处游荡，找点东西来蹭……

lines.en: : I get it. I did the same when I first came to Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 我懂。我刚来 Kumon-mi 的时候也是这样。

lines.en: : Ah! Kumon-mi! I remember that place...
lines.zh: : 啊！Kumon-mi！我还记得那个地方……
: 哇，都已经那么久了……

lines.en: : Do you have any desire to go back? I can probably take you with me, you know.
lines.zh: : 你想回去吗？我大概能带你一起走，你知道的。

lines.en: : And leave Shota behind? I can’t do that, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 然后把 Shota 丢下？我做不到，Sensei。
: 他不是死了吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. But in a sense, aren’t we all?
lines.zh: : 是啊。不过从某种意义上说，我们不都死了吗？

lines.en: : If time won’t move and {i}we{/i} won’t change, we’re all just walking corpses.
lines.zh: : 如果时间不肯走，而{i}我们{/i}也不肯变，那我们都只是会走路的尸体罢了。
: 这倒提醒我了——
{i}Sensei 获得了一颗{b}尸花种子{/b}！{/i}
: 这是什么？

lines.en: : A seed that’ll help you grow a corpseflower. Something to remember me by when you finish building your Maya and stop coming to see me.
lines.zh: : 一颗能让你种出尸花的种子。等你把 Maya 拼好、不再来看我的时候，可以拿它来想起我。

lines.en: : Fortunately for you, I still have some pieces to collect. So we can keep hanging out for a little while.
lines.zh: : 对你来说幸运的是，我还有几块没收集到。所以我们还能再一起玩一阵子。

lines.en: : And if you just so happen to have a piece of her-
lines.zh: : 要是你手上有她的一块——
: 骑它？

lines.en: : What? No. Give it to me.
lines.zh: : 什么？不。给我。
: 好让{i}你{/i}去骑它？

lines.en: : Sana, not everything has to be about sex.
lines.zh: : Sana，不是所有事都非得跟性有关。

lines.en: : You’ve changed, Sensei...I’m finally more like you and now you’re just pushing me away.
lines.zh: : 你变了，Sensei……我终于变得像你了，可你现在却把我推开。

lines.en: : I’ll never give you my piece of Maya at this rate.
lines.zh: : 这样下去我永远都不会把那块 Maya 给你了。

lines.en: : Then you leave me no choice but to make you something you won’t be able to say no to.
lines.zh: : 那你就是逼我非得做出一个你无法拒绝的东西了。

lines.en: : Nobody can say no if you just cover their mouth with your hand.
lines.zh: : 只要用手捂住别人的嘴，谁都拒绝不了。

lines.en: : And, on that note, I am leaving.
lines.zh: : 那么，就此告辞。

lines.en: : Okay...but you’ll know where to find me if you need to let off some steam.
lines.zh: : 好吧……不过你要是想发泄一下，知道去哪儿找我就行。

lines.en: : Shotaaaaa! Where are- oh, right. You can’t move.
lines.zh: : Shotaaaaa！你在哪儿——哦，对。你动不了。

lines.en: I leave Sana behind at the Unbleached Beach and figure out where to go from here...
lines.zh: 我把 Sana 留在未漂白海滩，想着接下来该去哪儿……
提出交易

lines.en: : I’d like to propose a trade.
lines.zh: : 我想提议一笔交易。
: 嗯……好啊……什么样的交易？……
回到外面

lines.en: : Actually, I think I’d rather go back outside and try and find something else for you. I know you won’t let go of your Maya fragment easily.
lines.zh: : 其实，我想我还是回外面去，给你另找点什么比较好。我知道你不会轻易交出那块 Maya 碎片的。
: 呵呵……这你说对了……

lines.en: : Come back when you have something for me...
lines.zh: : 等你有东西给我的时候再来吧……

lines.en: I head back outside to gather my thoughts and figure something else out.
lines.zh: 我回到外面，整理思绪，想着还能搞出点什么名堂。
尸冠

lines.en: I remove the corpsecrown from my inventory and immediately capture Sana’s attention.
lines.zh: 我从物品栏里取出尸冠，立刻就抓住了 Sana 的注意力。
: 那是……

lines.en: : I made it out of the seed you gave me. It was a little difficult cutting it down to a size that could fit a crown, but I think the end result is pretty good.
lines.zh: : 我用你给我的种子做的。要把它削到能当冠冕的大小有点费劲，不过我觉得成品相当不错。
: 你喜欢吗？

lines.en: : Do you...want to try it on?
lines.zh: : 你……想试试戴上吗？
: 我可以吗？……
: 当然。给你。

lines.en: I hand the corpsecrown over to Sana, who then places it over her head with trembling fingers, gazing up at the splintering wood I used to make it as if it’s meant to hold her skull in place.
lines.zh: 我把尸冠递给 Sana，她用颤抖的手指把它戴到头上，抬眼望着我用来做它的那些开裂的木片，仿佛它们本该是固定她头骨的东西。

lines.en: Her gaze is trapped there for a moment before it shoots to me. And then to nothing.
lines.zh: 她的目光在那里停留了片刻，然后猛地转向我。接着转向了虚无。

lines.en: Her eyes glaze over and develop a fine blue film over them that makes it appear as if she is a snake about to shed its skin.
lines.zh: 她的眼睛蒙上一层雾，浮起一层细薄的蓝膜，让她看起来像一条正要蜕皮的蛇。

lines.en: Her mouth drops open, emitting a low hum as the crown settles into her.
lines.zh: 她的嘴张开，发出一声低吟，那顶冠冕正在她身上安顿下来。
: 很酷吧？
: {size=-10}啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊……{/size}

lines.en: : I...take it we have a deal, then?
lines.zh: : 我……就当我们成交了？
: {size=-10}啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！{/size}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的躯干{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的骨盆{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左腿{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右腿{b}!{/i}
: 太棒了。谢了，Sana。
: {size=-10}啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊？？？？？{/size}

lines.en: : Right. Well, I’ll see you later then.
lines.zh: : 好。那我们回头见。
: {size=-10}啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！？！？！？&&！？！？！！？！@@！！{/size}

lines.en: I leave Sana and head back outside to figure out where to go from here.
lines.zh: 我离开 Sana，回到外面想接下来该去哪儿。
薰衣草香水

lines.en: : How about some lavender perfume? It smells like-
lines.zh: : 来点薰衣草香水怎么样？它闻起来像——
: 不要。

lines.en: : You didn’t even let me finish. It smells like lavender.
lines.zh: : 你连让我说完都不肯。它闻起来像薰衣草。

lines.en: : I don’t want to smell like lavender...I want to smell like dried cum and sweat...
lines.zh: : 我不想闻起来像薰衣草……我想闻起来像干掉的精液和汗……

lines.en: : Just...personal preference, I guess...it makes me feel more human and less artificial...
lines.zh: : 只是……个人偏好吧，我猜……那让我觉得自己更像个人，没那么假……

lines.en: : It’s something you have to work for rather than something that comes from a bottle...
lines.zh: : 那是得靠努力挣来的东西，而不是从瓶子里倒出来的东西……

lines.en: : Would it help knowing the perfume has a special mystery fluid I found in Ami’s room?
lines.zh: : 要是告诉你这香水里掺了我在 Ami 房间里找到的某种特殊神秘液体，会有帮助吗？
: 我能喝吗？
: 呃……大概不行？

lines.en: : Mm...I think I’ll pass then, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 嗯……那我还是算了，Sensei……

lines.en: : Do you have any other offers?
lines.zh: : 你还有别的提议吗？
: 呃……等等。让我想想。
鸦片

lines.en: : How about some opium? It might take your necrophilia to the next level.
lines.zh: : 来点鸦片怎么样？说不定能把你的恋尸癖提升到新境界。

lines.en: : It also might impact my thinking...and I’m the type who enjoys being fully immersed in my actions, Sensei...even when they’re actions I haven’t chosen for myself.
lines.zh: : 它也可能会影响我的思维……而我是那种喜欢全身心沉浸在自己行为里的人，Sensei……哪怕那些行为不是我自己选的。
: 我没懂。

lines.en: : Like...if someone chooses what to do with me and doesn’t give me any say in it...I still want to experience it all...even if I {i}hate{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 就是说……如果有人替我决定要对我做什么，而且根本不给我发言权……我还是想把一切都体验一遍……哪怕我{i}恨{/i}它。
: 还是没懂。

lines.en: : Have you been taking the opium too? I think I’d...be more open to it if we did it together...
lines.zh: : 你也吸过鸦片吗？如果我们一起吸，我觉得我……会更愿意接受。

lines.en: : Me? No. I need to be completely lucid for when I reassemble Maya. If I put a single part where it doesn’t belong, she might never be able to walk in the correct direction again.
lines.zh: : 我？没有。我拼 Maya 的时候得保持绝对清醒。只要我把一个部件放错地方，她可能就再也没法朝正确的方向走路了。

lines.en: : I guess I have to...refuse your offer, then...
lines.zh: : 那我大概只能……拒绝你的提议了……

lines.en: : But if you have something else...I’d be happy to hear it?
lines.zh: : 不过如果你有别的东西……我很乐意听听？
玫瑰花束

lines.en: : How about a nice bouquet of roses to show you how much I care?
lines.zh: : 来一束漂亮的玫瑰，表示我有多在乎你，怎么样？

lines.en: : Roses?...What am I supposed to do with those?...
lines.zh: : 玫瑰？……我拿它们来干什么？……

lines.en: : You can’t hump a rose...it’ll break...
lines.zh: : 玫瑰又不能骑……它会断的……

lines.en: : It’s not about the humping. It’s about having a physical representation of my feelings for you.
lines.zh: : 重点不是骑。重点是用一个实物来代表我对你的感情。

lines.en: : Can you...not just use the “physical representation” that’s dangling there between your legs?...
lines.zh: : 你就不能直接拿你两腿之间挂着那个“实物代表”吗？……

lines.en: : I could. But it feels wrong to receive a piece of Maya in exchange for my body when hers is so much better.
lines.zh: : 我可以。但用我的身体换一块 Maya，总觉得不对——毕竟她的身子好太多了。

lines.en: : You know mine...isn’t that much different, right?...
lines.zh: : 你知道我的……也差不了多少吧？……

lines.en: : Your ribs are slightly more visible. You need to eat more.
lines.zh: : 你的肋骨稍微明显了点。你得多吃点。
: 那就喂我吧，Sensei……{i}喂我……{/i}

lines.en: : Fill me up with your love...
lines.zh: : 用你的爱把我填满……

lines.en: Looks like Sana doesn’t want roses. I’ll have to try something else.
lines.zh: 看来 Sana 不想要玫瑰。我得试试别的。
金鱼草手链

lines.en: : How about a snapdragon bracelet? I made it myself.
lines.zh: : 那这条金鱼草手链怎么样？我自己做的。

lines.en: : Would someone...really trade you a body part for this?...
lines.zh: : 真会有人……为了这个跟你换一个身体部件吗？……

lines.en: : Appendages alone go for a few thousand on the black market...I could get a bracelet from a vending machine for around 100 yen...
lines.zh: : 光是四肢在黑市上就能卖几千……而我从自动贩卖机花大概 100 日元就能买到一条手链……

lines.en: : Is it not the thought that counts to you? I worked hard on this.
lines.zh: : 对你来说，心意就不算数吗？我可是花了很大功夫的。

lines.en: : I don’t...really care {i}how{/i} hard you worked...
lines.zh: : 我……不太在乎你花了{i}多少{/i}功夫……

lines.en: : If I’m going to give up my piece of Maya, I need something of equal or greater value...a tiny bracelet just...isn’t that, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我要是打算让出我那块 Maya，就得换到同等或更高价值的东西……一条小小的手链……不是那个，Sensei……

lines.en: : Damn it. Let’s see what else I have.
lines.zh: : 该死。看看我还剩什么。
回到外面

lines.en: : Actually, I think I’d rather go back outside and try and find something else for you. I know you won’t let go of your Maya fragment easily.
lines.zh: : 其实，我想我还是回外面去，给你另找点什么比较好。我知道你不会轻易交出那块 Maya 碎片的。
: 呵呵……这你说对了……

lines.en: : Come back when you have something for me...
lines.zh: : 等你有东西给我的时候再来吧……

lines.en: I head back outside to gather my thoughts and figure something else out.
lines.zh: 我回到外面，整理思绪，想着还能搞出点什么名堂。

: Makoto? Are you there? I want to talk to you again.
lines.zh: : Makoto？你在吗？我想再和你聊聊。
: 哦，Sensei。欢迎回来。

lines.en: : Are you here to try and earn some sticks?
lines.zh: : 你是来试着挣点树枝的吗？
: 那还用说。

lines.en: : Let’s hear some riddles, Makoto. It’s time to knock your socks off.
lines.zh: : 放马过来吧 Makoto，出谜题吧。是时候让你大吃一惊了。

lines.en: I arrive at what looks like the remnants of a children’s television show set, but there’s a plaque near the door referring to this building as the “Smile Mile.”
lines.zh: 我来到一处看起来像是某档儿童电视节目布景残骸的地方，可门边的铭牌上写着这栋建筑叫“微笑一英里”。

lines.en: It smells faintly of peppermint and there’s a light green mist bleeding in through the vents that I’m not sure what to make of. I don’t think the scent is coming from that.
lines.zh: 空气里有一丝淡淡的薄荷味，通风口还渗进浅绿色的雾气，我不太确定该怎么理解。我觉得那味道不是从雾里来的。

lines.en: I don’t really care either way, though. And if I need to deal with a little green mist to uncover a piece of Maya’s body, so be-
lines.zh: 不过无论如何我也不在乎。要是必须对付一点绿雾才能找到一块 Maya 的身体，那就——
: Sensei？是你吗？

lines.en: : Makoto? How’d you get into the Smile Mile? I hopped like seven fences to make it inside of here and there’s no way you’re that athletic.
lines.zh: : Makoto？你怎么进到微笑一英里里来的？我跳了七道栅栏才进来，你不可能有那么好的身手。

lines.en: : I was invited by a good friend of mine. I assumed that the two of you may have already been acquainted, but that doesn’t seem to be the case.
lines.zh: : 我是受我一位好朋友邀请来的。我原以为你们两个已经认识了，不过看来并非如此。
: 你在找什么东西吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I have Maya’s head in a bag, but I need to collect the rest of her to-
lines.zh: : 是啊。我手里有 Maya 的头，装在袋子里，但我得把剩下的部分收集齐才能——
: 别说了。给你。
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的躯干{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的骨盆{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左腿{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右腿{b}!{/i}
: 哇，真的吗？就这么给我了？

lines.en: : Of course. What use do {i}I{/i} have for Maya’s body?
lines.zh: : 当然。Maya 的身体对{i}我{/i}有什么用？

lines.en: : I was actually holding onto that in hopes that you’d show up. You seemed pretty distraught when you opened that box from Ami.
lines.zh: : 其实我一直替你保管着，就是盼着你出现。你打开 Ami 那个盒子的时候，看起来相当崩溃。

lines.en: : What box? I’m not allowed to open boxes. The game doesn’t let me.
lines.zh: : 什么盒子？我不被允许打开盒子。游戏不允许。

lines.en: : Ahh, I see. You haven’t grown your reset legs yet. That might make this next part difficult then.
lines.zh: : 啊，我明白了。你还没长出你的重置腿。那接下来的部分对你来说可能会有点难。

lines.en: : Next part? What next part? Are you holding out on me, Makoto? Do you have more body parts back there?
lines.zh: : 接下来的部分？什么接下来的部分？你还有东西瞒着我吗，Makoto？你后面还藏着更多身体部件？

lines.en: : No more body parts, unfortunately. But I {i}do{/i} have a large collection of sticks that you could probably find something to do with.
lines.zh: : 可惜没有更多身体部件了。不过我{i}确实{/i}有一大堆树枝，你大概能拿它们做点什么。

lines.en: : Sorry. Sticks? What am I supposed to do with sticks?
lines.zh: : 抱歉。树枝？我拿树枝能干什么？

lines.en: : You could use them as some sort of crafting reagent, I suppose? Or perhaps there’s just someone else out there who’s really interested in sticks? I don’t know.
lines.zh: : 你可以把它们当成某种制作材料？或者，说不定外面还有谁特别喜欢树枝？我不知道。

lines.en: : I mean, I can {i}try.{/i} Hand them over and I’ll see what I can-
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，我可以{i}试试{/i}。交给我，我看看能——

lines.en: : Ah! Not so fast, Sensei. That piece of Maya may have been on the house, but these sticks are a lot more valuable than that.
lines.zh: : 啊！别急，Sensei。那块 Maya 也许是我白送的，但这些树枝可比它值钱多了。

lines.en: : I’m {i}still{/i} willing to let go of them for free, of course. No one wants you to succeed more than I do. But I need to know that you’re serious about escaping this time.
lines.zh: : 我{i}依然{/i}愿意免费给你，当然。没有人比我更希望你成功。但我得知道，这一次你是认真的想逃出去。

lines.en: : Do you see this face, Makoto? This is my serious face. I am {i}so{/i} serious right now. Give me the sticks.
lines.zh: : 你看到这张脸了吗，Makoto？这就是我认真的脸。我现在{i}超级{/i}认真。把树枝给我。

lines.en: : I can’t, Sensei. I need you to prove {i}how{/i} serious you are by showing me how much attention you’ve been paying. So I’ve prepared a handful of riddles.
lines.zh: : 不行，Sensei。我需要你证明你{i}有多{/i}认真，让我看看你平时有多留心。所以我准备了几个谜题。

lines.en: : Ughhhhhh! I {i}knew{/i} there’d be questions again. I hate paying attention.
lines.zh: : 唔啊啊啊啊！我{i}就知道{/i}又会有问题。我最讨厌专心了。

lines.en: : Thankfully, you should only need about half of them to achieve your goal. And you can guess as many times as you like. Does that work for you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 幸好，你大概只需要答对一半就能达成目标。而且你想猜几次都行。这样你觉得可以吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I mean...it’s better than nothing, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……总比什么都没有强吧。
: 太好了！那我们开始吧。

lines.en: : Be it torture or torment, whatever you need, there’s a White Princess waiting to swallow your seed.
lines.zh: : 无论是折磨还是苦痛，无论你需要什么，都有一位白公主等着吞下你的种子。

lines.en: : Countless spidersilk hammocks she happily weaves, laced with infinite toxins you shan’t ever leave.
lines.zh: : 她愉快地织出无数蛛丝吊床，缠着无尽的毒素，让你再也离不开。
: 她的名字是什么？
: Gossamer，苦痛之神！
: 答得好，Sensei！
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}一根树枝{/b}！{/i}

lines.en: : I knew you had it in you. Now just replicate that success nine more times and you’ll have aced my quiz!
lines.zh: : 我就知道你能行。只要再把这样的成功重复九次，你就满分通过我的测验了！

lines.en: : It’s so lame that you’re being a smart girl here in brain-vacation.
lines.zh: : 你在这个大脑度假的地方还当个聪明女孩，真是扫兴。

lines.en: : You’ll thank me later, I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 你以后会谢我的，我保证。

lines.en: : Are you ready for the next question?
lines.zh: : 准备好下一题了吗？
是
: 太他妈好了，Makoto。放马过来。
否

lines.en: : I think I’m good for now. I’ll come back when I need more sticks, though.
lines.zh: : 我觉得先这样吧。等我还需要树枝的时候再回来。

lines.en: : Okay! I’ll be here. Just call out to me and tell me you’re ready for more.
lines.zh: : 好的！我会在这儿。只要喊我一声，告诉我你准备好了就行。
: 谢了，Makoto。你最棒了。

lines.en: I exit the Smile Mile and spend the next few minutes figuring out where to go from here.
lines.zh: 我走出微笑一英里，花了几分钟想接下来该去哪儿。

lines.en: The place that I’ll go next is-
lines.zh: 我接下来要去的地方是——
: [buildamayaquiz1]！
: 抱歉，Sensei。答错了。

lines.en: : Shoot. I thought I had that one.
lines.zh: : 靠。我以为这题我对了。

lines.en: : Do you want to try again?
lines.zh: : 想再试一次吗？
是

lines.en: : Fuck it. Yeah. Ask me again.
lines.zh: : 管他呢。好。再问我一遍。
否

lines.zh: : 我觉得先这样吧。等我还需要树枝的时候再回来。

lines.en: The place that I’ll go next is-
lines.zh: 我接下来要去的地方是-

lines.en: : If you ever feel sad and forget how to smile, abandon your fears and rest here for a while.
lines.zh: : 若你感到悲伤，忘了该怎么微笑，就放下恐惧，在这里歇一会儿。

lines.en: : A man with five heads but only four faces. Just don’t make him mad, for it’s air he displaces.
lines.zh: : 一个男人有五颗头，却只有四张脸。只是别惹他生气，因为他挪动的是空气。
: 他的名字是什么？
: Giuseppe，小丑之神！
: 答得好，Sensei！
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}一根树枝{/b}！{/i}

lines.en: The place that I’ll go next is-
lines.zh: 我接下来要去的地方是-

lines.en: : A cage for your heart and the things you’ve done wrong. Four ears to remember the words of each song.
lines.zh: : 关住你的心、还有你做过的错事的笼子。四只耳朵，记住每一首歌的词。

lines.en: : A chance for a wish to fulfill your ambitions. Your misdeeds mean nothing if he says you’re forgiven.
lines.zh: : 一次许愿的机会，好实现你的野心。只要他说你被原谅了，你的罪过就不算什么。
: 他的名字是什么？
: Pegasus，无匹的宽恕之神！
: 答得好，Sensei！

lines.en: : If the world is a game, then there must be a master. Or at least someone who will keep track.
lines.zh: : 如果世界是一场游戏，那就必然有一位主宰。或者至少有个负责记录的人。

lines.en: : On the wings of white noise, he can play what comes after a choice you can’t ever take back.
lines.zh: : 乘着白噪音的翅膀，他能播放一个你永远无法收回的选择之后发生的事。
: 他的名字是什么？
: Halftone，存档之神！
: 答得好，Sensei！
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}一根树枝{/b}！{/i}

lines.en: : You’re doing awesome! You’re almost halfway done now.
lines.zh: : 你太厉害了！你已经快完成一半了！

lines.en: : Are you ready for the next one?
lines.zh: : 准备好下一题了吗？
是

lines.en: : How nice it would be to sleep in her bosom, dodging claws or the cords in her hair.
lines.zh: : 若能睡在她的怀里该有多好，躲开她的爪子，或是她发丝间那些绳结。

lines.en: : For when I wake up and the sun starts to shine, a glass of her warmth is already prepared.
lines.zh: : 等我醒来、太阳开始照耀时，一杯她的温热早已备好。

lines.en: : A creator of many, yet a peer of no one. If you call him a clown, you’re a bother.
lines.zh: : 造物者众多，却无人能与他比肩。你若叫他小丑，那你就是个麻烦。

lines.en: : His domain is familiar. His power is unmatched. He’s the one we call Sorrowful Father.
lines.zh: : 他的领域为人熟悉。他的力量无可匹敌。他就是我们所称的悲伤之父。
: 他的名字是什么？
: Apollo，无匹的悲哀之神！
: 我的{b}天啊{/b}！你做到了！
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}一根树枝{/b}！{/i}

lines.en: : That’s amazing! You answered every single question correctly!
lines.zh: : 太厉害了！你每一道题都答对了！

lines.en: : I have so many sticks now.
lines.zh: : 我现在有好多树枝了。

lines.en: : You sure do. But unfortunately, that means I don’t have {i}any{/i} anymore. And that’s kind of upsetting.
lines.zh: : 你确实是。可遗憾的是，这意味着我{i}一根{/i}都没有了。而这多少有点让人难过。

lines.en: : I’ve grown pretty attached to those sticks lately.
lines.zh: : 我最近已经相当依恋那些树枝了。

lines.en: : If it makes you feel any better, they’ll all be going to a good cause.
lines.zh: : 要是这能让你好受点的话，它们全都会用在正道上。

lines.en: : I believe you, Sensei. I know you’ll complete your rebuild of Maya any day now. And when you do, I hope to be right there on the other side when you return to our world.
lines.zh: : 我相信你，Sensei。我知道你随时可能完成 Maya 的重建。等你完成的时候，我希望能在你回到我们那个世界时，就站在另一边等着。
: 大概会站在那儿的是 Ayane 吧。
: 嗯，你大概是对的。

lines.en: : Either way, Makoto, you’ve been a huge help. I need to go put these sticks to work, though. I refuse to let you down this time.
lines.zh: : 不管怎么说，Makoto，你帮了大忙。不过我得去让这些树枝派上用场了。这次我绝不让你失望。

lines.en: : I’ll hold you to that, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我会记住你这句话的，Sensei……
: 祝你一切顺利。

lines.zh: : 想再试一次吗？
是
