lines.en: : Really? You’re just...going to leave in the middle of the very last question?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？你就这么……要在最后一题做到一半的时候走掉？
: 一点没错。

lines.en: : Sensei, no! Come back! You can’t just leave me in suspense like this!
lines.zh: : Sensei，不要！回来！你不能就这么把我吊在悬念里！

lines.en: I sure can. So I exit the Smile Mile and spend the next few minutes figuring out where to go from here.
lines.zh: 我当然能。于是我走出微笑一英里，花了几分钟想接下来该去哪儿。

lines.en: The place that I’ll go next is-
lines.zh: 我接下来要去的地方是-

lines.en: : Makoto? Are you there? I want to talk to you again.
lines.zh: : Makoto？你在吗？我想再和你聊聊。
: Sensei？……

lines.en: : What are you doing here? You’ve already answered all of my questions.
lines.zh: : 你在这儿干什么？我的问题你都已经答完了啊。

lines.en: : I wanted to give you this.
lines.zh: : 我想把这个给你。

lines.en: {i}Sensei has gifted the {b}Ultimate Stick Bouquet{/b} to Makoto!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Sensei 把{b}究极树枝花束{/b}送给了 Makoto！{/i}

lines.en: : I had some extra sticks left over after making a bunch of trinkets and I figured I’d craft something for {i}you{/i} as a means of thanking you for all of your help.
lines.zh: : 我做完一堆小玩意儿之后还剩了些树枝，就想给你{i}也{/i}做点什么，好谢谢你帮了我那么多忙。

lines.en: : I’d be stuck in here forever if it wasn’t for you, Makoto.
lines.zh: : 要不是你，我大概会永远困在这儿，Makoto。
: 我的树枝……
: 它们现在好美啊……

lines.en: : Perhaps they’ve {i}always{/i} been beautiful...and we just couldn’t see it.
lines.zh: : 也许它们{i}一直{/i}都那么美……只是我们看不见罢了。

lines.en: : Sensei, I...I know they’re just {i}sticks,{/i} but...this really means a lot to me.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我……我知道它们只是{i}树枝{/i}，可是……这对我来说意义重大。

lines.en: : To think that you’d learn how to make the {b}Ultimate Stick Bouquet{/b} in such a short amount of time and then...give it to {i}me{/i} of all people?
lines.zh: : 想想看，你居然在这么短的时间里学会了制作{b}究极树枝花束{/b}，然后……还把它给了这么多人里的{i}我{/i}？
: 我不明白……

lines.en: : You don’t need to. You just need to accept it.
lines.zh: : 你不需要明白。你只需要收下。

lines.en: : Accept it and live your life, Makoto. Escape from the Smile Mile and go back home. Be free.
lines.zh: : 收下它，然后过你自己的生活，Makoto。从微笑一英里逃出去，回你的家去。自由吧。

lines.en: : I mean...I kind of {i}can’t{/i} until you finish your mission.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……在你完成使命之前，我{i}大概做不到{/i}。
: 可-可是！而且，呃……好-好吧。那么……

lines.en: : I actually...{i}do{/i} have something else that...I didn’t tell you about before. But only because I didn’t think you were ready!
lines.zh: : 其实我……{i}确实{/i}还有一样东西……之前没告诉你的。但那只是因为我觉得你还没准备好！

lines.en: : I {i}knew{/i} you had extra body parts back there.
lines.zh: : 我{i}就知道{/i}你后面还藏着多余的身体部件。

lines.en: : It’s not an extra body part! Just...wait here, okay? I’ll be back in one minute!
lines.zh: : 不是多余的身体部件！只是……在这儿等一下，好吗？我一分钟就回来！
: 我会数着的……
: 好了！我回来了。

lines.en: : That was only fifty-seven seconds. You have deceived me.
lines.zh: : 那只有五十七秒。你骗了我。

lines.en: : That’s a level of pedantry even I have a hard time accepting. But here!
lines.zh: : 这种程度的钻牛角尖连我都很难接受。不过，给！

lines.en: : This is my final gift to you...
lines.zh: : 这是我给你的最后一份礼物……
{i}Sensei 获得了一条{b}锦鲤{/b}！{/i}

lines.en: : Woah! You’re seriously going to trust me with a koi? This guy is huge. He’s gotta be worth at least $10.
lines.zh: : 哇！你真的放心把一条锦鲤交给我？这家伙个头真大。它至少值 10 美元吧。
: 远不止这些，Sensei。

lines.en: : Well, duh. That’s why I said “at least.” Where did you even get it, though?
lines.zh: : 嗯，废话。所以我才说“至少”。不过你到底是从哪儿弄来的？

lines.en: : I caught it while I was fishing somewhere I wasn’t supposed to. It’s probably illegal. But it’s also yours now, so that’s not my problem anymore.
lines.zh: : 我在一个不该钓鱼的地方钓上来的。大概算是违法的吧。不过它现在是你的了，所以那就不关我的事了。

lines.en: : Makoto Miyamura, you have turned me into a criminal.
lines.zh: : Makoto Miyamura，你把我变成罪犯了。
: 我的意思是……{i}是我吗{/i}？

lines.en: : I have no idea what you’re talking about. Anyway, you enjoy the sticks and I will enjoy this fish. I am suddenly hungry.
lines.zh: : 我不知道你在说什么。总之，你享受你的树枝，我享受这条鱼。我突然饿了。

lines.en: : You’re not going to eat him, are you? Because I want you to look after him, Sensei. Give him a home. Do what {i}I{/i} can’t.
lines.zh: : 你该不会要把它吃了吧？因为我想要你好好照顾它，Sensei。给它一个家。做这些{i}我{/i}做不到的事。
: 嗯……为什么你{i}做不到{/i}？
: 因为它现在是你的了。
: 可那是-
: 再见！

lines.en: : Well...I guess I have a fish now?
lines.zh: : 嗯……看来我现在有鱼了？

lines.en: I exit the Smile Mile and spend the next few minutes figuring out where to go from here.
lines.zh: 我走出微笑一英里，花了几分钟想接下来该去哪儿。

lines.en: The place that I’ll go next is-
lines.zh: 我接下来要去的地方是-

lines.en: : I just wanted to say hi.
lines.zh: : 我只是想打个招呼。
: 哦。好吧。你好。
: 你好。
: 就这些？
: 嗯。回头见，Makoto。
: 哦……好吧。

lines.en: I exit the Smile Mile and spend the next few minutes figuring out where to go from here.
lines.zh: 我走出微笑一英里，花了几分钟想接下来该去哪儿。

lines.en: The place that I’ll go next is-
lines.zh: 我接下来要去的地方是-

lines.en: : Chika? Are you there? I want to talk to you again.
lines.zh: : Chika？你在吗？我想再和你聊聊。

lines.en: : Mhm! Welcome back, Sensei. The sale’s extended until Maya’s finally put back together.
lines.zh: : 嗯！欢迎回来，Sensei。促销会一直持续到 Maya 终于被拼好为止。
: 怎么了？

lines.en: Now that the mall is finally open again, I decide to head on over and see if any of the shops are selling pieces of Maya.
lines.zh: 商场总算重新开门了，我决定过去看看有没有哪家店在卖 Maya 的碎片。

lines.en: What I find instead is quite shocking, though. It appears as if an orgy is taking place here. The mall {i}I{/i} am currently accustomed to never had those.
lines.zh: 不过我看到的景象着实让人震惊。这里似乎正在举行一场群交派对。我{i}熟知的{/i}那家商场可从来没有这种东西。

lines.en: Times sure are changing, huh? It must be all of that fluoride in the water.
lines.zh: 时代真是变了啊。肯定是水里的氟化物闹的。

lines.en: : Sensei! Hey! Welcome to the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event! You just missed Chinami. She would have been so happy to see you.
lines.zh: : Sensei！嘿！欢迎光临 Spacy 夏日狂欢大促！你刚好错过了 Chinami。她要是见到你肯定高兴坏了。

lines.en: : You brought your little sister to an orgy?
lines.zh: : 你把你妹妹带到群交派对来了？

lines.en: : Hm? Of course not! She was here before {i}I{/i} was. But apparently it’s not as big of a deal as you’d expect. I’ll admit, though. I was pretty shocked at first too.
lines.zh: : 嗯？当然不是！她比我{i}还{/i}早在这儿。不过看来这事儿没你想的那么严重。不过我承认，一开始我也挺震惊的。

lines.en: : You just looking to shop? Or do you need a partner for the ritual? Because I’m still searching as well.
lines.zh: : 你只是来逛街的？还是需要一个仪式的搭档？因为我也还在找。

lines.en: : Or...I guess “waiting” would be more accurate. Nobody here has really suited my tastes until you showed up. But now that you’re {i}here,{/i} we can finally join in!
lines.zh: : 或者……我想“等着”会更准确。在你出现之前，这里没有一个人真正合我的胃口。不过既然你{i}来了{/i}，我们终于可以加入了！

lines.en: : I hear the pair who lasts the longest gets a prize. And you and I both know that we can knock these losers out of the water.
lines.zh: : 我听说撑到最后的一对能拿奖。而且你我都清楚，我们能把这些废物打得落花流水。

lines.en: : Is the prize a piece of Maya by any chance?
lines.zh: : 奖品该不会正好是一块 Maya 吧？

lines.en: : I don’t think so. I’m pretty sure it’s some kind of helmet, actually.
lines.zh: : 应该不是。我挺确定那是某种头盔。

lines.en: : {i}I{/i} have a piece of Maya, though.
lines.zh: : 不过{i}我{/i}手上有一块 Maya。

lines.en: : Un-fuck. That’s awesome, Chika. Can I have it?
lines.zh: : 那就不操了。太棒了，Chika。能给我吗？

lines.en: : Depends. What are you gonna do with it?
lines.zh: : 看情况。你打算拿它干什么？

lines.en: : Add it to my collection bag and ultimately put her back together so Horseface Taki will let me leave.
lines.zh: : 放进我的收集袋，最后把她拼回去，好让马脸 Taki 放我走。
: 马脸 Taki 是谁？

lines.en: : The God of the Track. Whatever that means. Cool guy. His voice is kind of hoarse, though.
lines.zh: : 赛道之神。管它是什么意思。挺酷的家伙。不过他嗓子有点哑。
: 哈哈哈哈！这个双关绝了，Sensei！
: 什么双关？
: 哦。呃……当我没说吧？

lines.en: : And Sensei, I love you, but I really can’t just let go of this Maya fragment for nothing. I’m going to need something in exchange for it.
lines.zh: : Sensei，我爱你，但我真的不能白白把这块 Maya 碎片让出去。我得拿它换点什么东西。

lines.en: : Can I not just be your orgy partner? Because we might have to go at it for days if these people are serious and that time is {i}worth{/i} something, Chika. I know this because I’m a professional.
lines.zh: : 我就不能当你的群交搭档吗？要是这些人来真的，我们可能得连干好几天，而那时间{i}可是值钱的{/i}，Chika。这点我清楚，因为我是专业人士。

lines.en: : You sure are, Sensei. And frankly, I think your experience is needed here. Like, just look at the couple to my left. There’s no way he’s got it inside. The angle is all wrong.
lines.zh: : 你当然是，Sensei。说实话，我觉得这里正需要你的经验。就说我左边那对情侣吧，他绝对没插进去。角度完全不对。

lines.en: : We have a deal then? I have a lot of sex with you and {i}you{/i} give me one of Maya’s body parts?
lines.zh: : 那我们成交了？我和你大干一场，{i}你{/i}给我一块 Maya 的身体部件？

lines.en: : I just can’t agree to that, unfortunately. Contest-slash-ritual rules don’t allow payment or bribery in exchange for sex. Any deal we make needs to be done behind the scenes.
lines.zh: : 可惜这个我真没法答应。比赛兼仪式的规则不允许以性爱换取报酬或贿赂。我们要做的任何交易都得在台面下进行。

lines.en: : Ugh. Nothing’s ever as easy as it looks, is it?
lines.zh: : 呃。没有一件事像看起来那么简单，是吧？

lines.en: : Doesn’t seem that way, no. But hey! You know what I like, so I’m sure you’ll find something worth trading me.
lines.zh: : 看起来确实不是。不过嘿！你知道我喜欢什么，所以我相信你总能找到值得跟我换的东西。

lines.en: : And in the meantime, you can have these!
lines.zh: : 在那之前，这些先给你！
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}玫瑰种子{/b}！{/i}
: 种子？

lines.en: : Mhm. Rose seeds. They’re worth their weight in gold if you can grow them. Or...maybe not {i}gold.{/i} But they’re definitely worth their weight in roses. Because...they {i}are{/i} roses.
lines.zh: : 嗯。玫瑰种子。你要是能种活，它们可比同重量的黄金还值钱。或者……也许{i}黄金{/i}谈不上。但它们绝对比同重量的玫瑰值钱。因为……它们{i}就是{/i}玫瑰。

lines.en: : You get what I’m saying, don’t you? Plant them and...do something with them. Then do {i}more{/i} things and return to me and-
lines.zh: : 你懂我意思吧？把它们种下去，然后……拿它们做点什么。再拿去做点{i}别的{/i}事，回来找我，然后-

lines.en: : Okay, yeah. I get it. Thanks, Chika.
lines.zh: : 好，行。我懂了。谢了，Chika。
: 嗯！为你做什么都行，Sensei。

lines.en: : So...can we start now? Because being around {i}this{/i} for so long has got me kind of {i}eager{/i} to join in, if you know what I mean.
lines.zh: : 那么……我们现在能开始了吗？因为在{i}这玩意儿{/i}旁边待了这么久，我已经有点{i}急{/i}着想加入了，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: : Maybe later. I need to finish crafting stuff for my mission first.
lines.zh: : 也许晚点吧。我得先把手头要做的东西做完。

lines.en: : Damn it! Even Chinami’s gonna beat me at this rate...
lines.zh: : 该死！照这个速度，连 Chinami 都要比我先了……

lines.en: : I don’t think she should be allowed here, but I don’t really have the time to enforce any rules. I have work to do.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不该让她来这种地方，不过我也真没空去执行什么规矩。我有活要干。

lines.en: : I’ll be here when you need me! Or {i}want{/i} me! Or {i}anything{/i} me! I’m so lonely and so left out!
lines.zh: : 你需要我的时候我就在这儿！或者{i}想要{/i}我的时候！或者{i}随便怎么{/i}我的时候！我好寂寞，好被冷落！

lines.en: And I am so busy, so I leave.
lines.zh: 我忙得很，所以先告辞了。
接下来去哪儿？
提出交易

lines.en: : I’d like to propose a trade.
lines.zh: : 我想跟你做笔交易。

lines.en: : Kay! What kind of trade do you have in mind?
lines.zh: : 好呀！你想怎么个换法？
回到外面

lines.en: : Actually, I don’t think I’m ready yet. Let me gather some more stuff and come back later.
lines.zh: : 其实我觉得还没准备好。我再去搜集点东西，晚点回来。

lines.en: : Okay! I’ll be here then. Just...waiting.
lines.zh: : 好吧！那我就在这儿等你。就……干等着。

lines.en: : Watching all these...other couples have sex...
lines.zh: : 看着这一对对……情侣做爱……

lines.en: I head back outside to gather my thoughts and figure something else out.
lines.zh: 我回到外面，好理清思绪，想想接下来该怎么办。
尸冠

lines.en: : How about this corpsecrown that I made from a giant flower and a bunch of sticks?
lines.zh: : 我用一朵巨型花和一堆树枝做的这顶尸冠，你觉得怎么样？

lines.en: : Ew, creepy. Why does it look like that?
lines.zh: : 咦，好瘆人。怎么长这副模样？

lines.en: : I think it might be alive.
lines.zh: : 我怀疑它是活的。

lines.en: : So you’re giving it to me as, like...a {i}pet?{/i} Like, am I supposed to feed it? Or what?
lines.zh: : 所以你是把它当……宠物送我？我还得喂它？还是怎么着？

lines.en: : I kind of hoped you’d just put it on your head and be like, “Cool, thanks” then give me a piece of Maya I could stuff in my bag.
lines.zh: : 我本来还指望你往头上一戴，说句「酷，谢了」，然后给我一块能塞进包里的 Maya 部件。

lines.en: : Oh, so it’s like some new kind of accessory then? Neat. Kinda retro, even. I don’t really think it fits my style, though.
lines.zh: : 哦，所以算是某种新款配饰？挺新鲜。甚至有点复古。不过我觉得不太搭我的风格。

lines.en: : Plus, it already smells pretty terrible in here and that crown isn’t exactly helping.
lines.zh: : 再说这儿本来就够难闻了，那顶冠一点忙也没帮上。

lines.en: : Damn it. Guess I’ll have to try something else then.
lines.zh: : 该死。看来我得换个法子了。
薰衣草香水

lines.en: : I can offer you this perfume I made?
lines.zh: : 我用这瓶自己做的香水跟你换，行吗？
: 哦哦，香水！让我看看！

lines.en: I try to hand Chika the tester bottle I made but, before I can, she snatches the {i}bigger{/i} bottle out of my hands and takes a swig of it.
lines.zh: 我正要把做好的试用装递给 Chika，她却抢先从我手里夺走那瓶{i}更大{/i}的，仰头灌了一口。
: 好喝！是薰衣草吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think you’re supposed to drink that.
lines.zh: : 这东西应该不是拿来喝的吧。

lines.en: : I do that with all of my perfumes when I’m testing them. I learned it from my mom.
lines.zh: : 我试香水的时候都这么喝。跟我妈学的。

lines.en: : No wonder she died so young.
lines.zh: : 难怪她走得那么早。

lines.en: Chika takes another swig of the lavender perfume I worked so hard on.
lines.zh: Chika 又灌了一口我费尽心思做出的薰衣草香水。
: 这里头有精液吗？

lines.en: : It’s possible. The only ingredient apart from lavender was some mystery fluid I found in a jar Ami was holding onto.
lines.zh: : 有可能。除了薰衣草，唯一的配料就是我从 Ami 一直抱着的那只罐子里找到的某种不明液体。
: 她真他妈怪。

lines.en: Chika takes another sip from the lavender cum bottle.
lines.zh: Chika 又从那瓶掺了精液的薰衣草香水里抿了一口。

lines.en: : Anyway, yeah. This is perfect, Sensei. And the lavender totally helps mask the smell of sex in here! I feel like a brand new girl all of a sudden!
lines.zh: : 总之，这东西太完美了，Sensei。而且薰衣草完全盖住了这儿的性气味！我突然觉得自己像个焕然一新的女孩！
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的躯干{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的骨盆{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左腿{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右腿{b}!{/i}

lines.en: : I wonder if that’s just because I haven’t had any cum in so long?
lines.zh: : 我在想，是不是只是因为我太久没吃到精液了？

lines.en: : Well...I wanted you to {i}wear{/i} the perfume, but I guess drinking it is fine too so long as I get my piece of Maya out of it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我本来是想让你{i}喷{/i}上香水的，不过既然能换到我要的 Maya 部件，你喝下去也行。

lines.en: : What are you gonna do once you finish rebuilding her? And also, you {i}are{/i} going to come back, right?
lines.zh: : 你把她重新拼好之后打算做什么？还有，你{i}会{/i}回来的，对吧？

lines.en: : Because, again, the sale ends once Maya’s put back together. And if I’m the one girl at this orgy who doesn’t get any dick, my self-esteem is going to take a real blow.
lines.zh: : 因为再说一遍，Maya 一拼回去，这场特卖就结束了。要是全场就我一个女孩没吃到鸡巴，我的自尊心可是会遭到重创的。
: 呃……大概吧？我也不知道。

lines.en: : I’m kind of busy right now, though. So I’ll see you later, Chika.
lines.zh: : 不过我现在挺忙的。那回头见，Chika。
: 什么——？！真的？！呃啊！

lines.en: : Guess it’s back to masturbating then...
lines.zh: : 那看来还是回去自慰吧……

lines.en: I leave Chika and head back outside to figure out where to go from here.
lines.zh: 我离开 Chika 回到外面，想想接下来该去哪儿。
鸦片

lines.en: : What’s a sex party without a little opium? Want to trade your piece of Maya for-
lines.zh: : 没有鸦片的性派对算什么性派对？想用你那块 Maya 换——

lines.en: : Sensei, no! I don’t do {i}drugs.{/i} I’ve seen the effect those had on Yumi and I still have a little sister to take care of.
lines.zh: : Sensei，别！我不碰{i}毒品{/i}。我见过那玩意儿把 Yumi 害成什么样，而且我还有个妹妹要照顾。

lines.en: : Where is she {i}now{/i} by the way?
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，她「{i}现在{/i}」在哪儿？

lines.en: : Idunno. Fucking some kind of dog-man I think?
lines.zh: : 谁知道。好像在跟什么狗人乱搞？

lines.en: : You’re right. Drugs would be a horrible influence on her.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。毒品对她会是很坏的影响。

lines.en: : Exactly. So put that stuff away and make me a better, more wholesome offer. I’m going to keep watching this orgy in the meantime.
lines.zh: : 就是。所以把那东西收起来，给我一个更正经的报价。这期间我继续看这场群交就好。

lines.en: Damn. Looks like Chika doesn’t want any opium.
lines.zh: 该死。看来 Chika 不想要鸦片。

lines.en: I’ll need to try something else.
lines.zh: 我得换个法子。
玫瑰束

lines.en: : How about this bouquet of roses? I did what you told me and turned them into a product. Now they are more valuable and worth at least one Maya part.
lines.zh: : 这束玫瑰怎么样？我照你说的把它们加工成了成品。现在它们更值钱了，至少抵得上一块 Maya 部件。

lines.en: : Oh, wow! You totally {i}did!{/i} You even replaced the stems and everything. And- oh! Are those fake thorns?
lines.zh: : 哇哦！你还真{i}做{/i}了！连花茎都换过了。而且——哦！那些刺是假的吗？

lines.en: : I am a master craftsman in this world. Life is so much better when I don’t destroy everything I touch.
lines.zh: : 在这个世界里，我可是工艺大师。不把碰到的东西全弄坏，日子好过多了。

lines.en: : It sounds like it. And, like...I {i}love{/i} the bouquet, don’t get me wrong, but roses are kind of {i}out{/i} right now. That’s why I gave you the seeds.
lines.zh: : 听着像是这么回事。而且我{i}很{/i}喜欢这束花，别误会，但玫瑰现在有点{i}过时{/i}了。所以我才把种子给你。

lines.en: : I have a reputation to uphold and can’t really be caught dead with them until they’re back in season.
lines.zh: : 我得维护自己的名声，在它们重新流行之前，被人撞见拿着玫瑰我可受不了。

lines.en: : But I worked so hard on this.
lines.zh: : 可我费了好大劲啊。

lines.en: : And you did great! I just...{i}don’t really want them...{/i}
lines.zh: : 你确实做得很好！我只是……{i}不怎么想要它们……{/i}

lines.en: : Maybe something else, though! What else do you have?
lines.zh: : 不过也许别的行！你还有什么？
金鱼草手链

lines.en: : I could give you this awesome snapdragon bracelet I made?
lines.zh: : 我用金鱼草做了条超棒的手链，给你怎么样？

lines.en: : Snapdragons? Did you get those from Yumi? I {i}thought{/i} I heard something about her raiding people’s gardens recently.
lines.zh: : 金鱼草？你从 Yumi 那儿弄来的？我{i}好像{/i}听说她最近在偷别人家花园里的花。

lines.en: : I got the seeds from her but grew the snapdragons myself. And it was really sad having to kill them for the sake of fashion, so I’d appreciate it if you would take their carcasses off my hands.
lines.zh: : 种子是她给的，但金鱼草是我自己种的。为了时尚把它们弄死真的很难过，所以你要是能收下它们的残骸，我会很感激。

lines.en: : I want to. Really. Just the Spacy’s Summer Blast Savings event has a strict “no bracelets” rule and I don’t want to get disqualified once we start.
lines.zh: : 我是想收。真的。只是 Spacy 的夏日狂欢特卖会有条严格的「禁止手链」规定，我不想等开始以后被取消资格。
: 只禁手链？为什么？

lines.en: : Anklets too. People started putting razorblades in them to sort of shock themselves out of arousal and keep themselves from cumming. Unfair advantage in a sex contest, unfortunately.
lines.zh: : 脚链也不行。有人往里面塞刀片，靠痛感把自己从兴奋里拽回来，好忍住不射。在性爱比赛里算不公平优势，没办法。

lines.en: : Or a handicap if you’re into bloodplay, I guess. Either way, I don’t make the rules.
lines.zh: : 或者说，要是你好「玩血」这口，那反倒是种劣势。总之规矩又不是我定的。

lines.en: : Is there anything else you can trade?
lines.zh: : 你还有别的东西可以换吗？
: 呃……我看看。
回到外面

lines.en: : Actually, I don’t think I’m ready yet. Let me gather some more stuff and come back later.
lines.zh: : 其实我觉得还没准备好。我再去搜集点东西，晚点回来。

lines.en: : Okay! I’ll be here then. Just...waiting.
lines.zh: : 好吧！那我就在这儿等你。就……干等着。

lines.en: : Watching all these...other couples have sex...
lines.zh: : 看着这一对对……情侣做爱……

lines.en: I head back outside to gather my thoughts and figure something else out.
lines.zh: 我回到外面，好理清思绪，想想接下来该怎么办。

lines.en: : Yumi? Are you there? I want to talk to you again.
lines.zh: : Yumi？你在吗？我想再跟你谈谈。
: 哈？你他妈想干嘛？

lines.en: Apparently, there is a district even older than the old one. And, even more apparently, I am there now. Which is odd because I don’t exactly remember {i}coming{/i} here.
lines.zh: 据说，还有一区比那个旧城区更旧。而更「据说」的是，我现在就站在那儿。这挺奇怪的，因为我完全不记得自己是怎么{i}来{/i}到这儿的。

lines.en: {size=-1}The sky twists and morphs and gives me slight motion sickness, but a peculiar sunflower peering over the wooden barrier emits a soft whirring noise that acts as verbal Dramamine and makes me feel a little better.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}天空扭曲变形，看得我有些发晕，但探出木栅栏的一株奇特向日葵发出轻轻的嗡嗡声，像一剂口服的晕海宁，让我好受了一些。{/size}
: 啊，操。

lines.en: : I ain’t even safe from you in a brand new world, am I?
lines.zh: : 哪怕换了个全新的世界，我也躲不开你，是吧？

lines.en: : Oh. Hey, Yumi. I guess it makes sense that you’d be here. Where’d all your clothes go?
lines.zh: : 哦。嗨，Yumi。你会在这儿倒也合理。你衣服都哪儿去了？

lines.en: : It’s hot as balls over here, ain’t it? And I don’t wanna fuckin’ deal with that, so birthday suit it is.
lines.zh: : 这儿热得要死，懂吗？我懒得受那份罪，干脆直接「生日装」上阵了。
: 厉害。那祝你生日快乐。

lines.en: : You’re a fucking idiot. Go home, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 你他妈是个白痴。回家去，Sensei。

lines.en: : I can’t. I need to collect a bunch of pieces of Maya and then reassemble them on my bed so we can return home together.
lines.zh: : 我不行。我得集齐 Maya 的部件，然后在我的床上把她重新拼起来，这样我们就能一起回家了。

lines.en: : Sounds like wishful thinkin’ to me. ‘Specially after I watched you pull her head from a goddamn box just a little while ago.
lines.zh: : 听着像是在做白日梦。尤其是我前不久才看着你把她的人头从一只该死的箱子里拽出来。

lines.en: : A box? Don’t you mean a {i}bag?{/i}
lines.zh: : 箱子？你是说{i}袋子{/i}吧？

lines.en: I remove Maya’s head from my sack and hold it out to Yumi by the hair.
lines.zh: 我从麻袋里取出 Maya 的头，拎着头发举到 Yumi 面前。

lines.en: : Ew! Put that shit away! I don’t want to fuckin’ look at a {i}head.{/i} It’s bad enough just keepin’ {i}this{/i} on me.
lines.zh: : 恶！把这玩意儿收起来！我可不想看什么{i}人头{/i}。光是身上{i}揣着这个{/i}就已经够糟了。

lines.en: Yumi vomits up one of Maya’s body parts to show me, holding it in her slimy hands before opening her mouth back up and swallowing it whole.
lines.zh: Yumi 呕出一块 Maya 的身体部件给我看，用黏糊糊的手捧着，随后又张开嘴，整块吞了回去。
: 姑娘总得吃饭。

lines.en: : I might have the head, sure. But at least {i}I{/i} have the decency to keep mine in a sack.
lines.zh: : 头{i}我{/i}确实有。但至少「我」还有点分寸，会把它装在袋子里。

lines.en: : Ain’t human bodies just sacks of meat at the end of the day? Ain’t no issue holdin’ shit like I do. I get some nutrients out of it too.
lines.zh: : 人的身体到头来不就是一袋肉吗？我这么装着东西也没什么问题。还能顺带补点营养。

lines.en: : Only downside is I get people like you tryin’ to come after me and tear open my body to get to the good stuff.
lines.zh: : 唯一的坏处就是会招来你这种人，想剖开我的身子掏走里面的好东西。

lines.en: : Someone else has come here searching for Maya parts? Who?
lines.zh: : 还有别人来这儿找过 Maya 的部件？谁？

lines.en: : Some dude in a purple hat. Didn’t give me a name. As you can see, though, part’s still in my possession.
lines.zh: : 一个戴紫帽子的男的。没报名字。不过你也看到了，部件还在我手上。

lines.en: : At least until somebody makes me a good offer, that is.
lines.zh: : 至少在有人出个好价钱之前是这样。

lines.en: : Well...what are you looking for exactly? Maybe I have something that-
lines.zh: : 那……你到底想要什么？说不定我手上正好有——

lines.en: : You ain’t got shit. I can tell by the look on your face.
lines.zh: : 你他妈什么都没有。看你那张脸我就知道。
: 可我——

lines.en: Yumi vomits something else up and throws it at me.
lines.zh: Yumi 又呕出一样东西，朝我扔了过来。
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}金鱼草种子{/b}！{/i}
: 呕。为什么？

lines.en: : Think that Maya fragment’s growing or some shit. Body’s probably tryin’ to make more room for it or whatever.
lines.zh: : 大概是那块 Maya 碎片在长还是什么的。身体可能在给它腾地方之类的。
: 这是花种子？

lines.en: : Like I said, fucker. Girl’s gotta eat. I don’t bitch about your diet, so you damn well better not bitch about mine.
lines.zh: : 我说了，混蛋。姑娘总得吃饭。我没对你的食谱指手画脚，所以你他妈最好也别对我的指手画脚。

lines.en: : Now get the fuck out of here and don’t come back until you’ve got somethin’ to trade. You hear me?
lines.zh: : 现在给我滚出去，没东西拿来换就别回来。听懂了吗？
: 呃……行吧。

lines.en: I sink into the cement and emerge in a strange field somewhere, slightly wet.
lines.zh: 我沉入水泥地，从一片陌生的田野里冒了出来，身上有点湿。
那现在该去哪儿？
提出交易

lines.en: : I’d like to propose a trade.
lines.zh: : 我想跟你做笔交易。
: 呃……行吧。你出什么？
回到外面

lines.en: : Actually, I think I’ll just come back another time. It seems like you’re in a bad mood.
lines.zh: : 其实我想还是改天再来吧。你看起来心情不太好。

lines.en: : The fuck would give you that idea, douche-monkey?
lines.zh: : 你他妈从哪儿看出来的，蠢猴子？
: 就那句。对不起，Yumi。

lines.en: : Good. Fuckin’ go then. See if I care.
lines.zh: : 很好。那你他妈滚吧。我才不在乎呢。

lines.en: I head back outside and try to figure out where to go from here.
lines.zh: 我回到外面，试着想想接下来该去哪儿。
现在怎么办？
尸冠

lines.en: : Could I interest you in this crown, my princess? It’s made of sticks and corpseflower bits.
lines.zh: : 我的公主，这顶冠您有兴趣吗？是用树枝和尸花碎片做的。

lines.en: : Can I interest {i}you{/i} in never fucking calling me your princess again? Put that stupid fucking crown away.
lines.zh: : 那{i}你{/i}有没有兴趣别他妈再叫我公主？把你那顶蠢冠收起来。

lines.en: : I think it’d look great on you, though. I probably should have made a tiara, huh?
lines.zh: : 可我觉得你戴上一定很好看。我大概该做顶王冠才对，嗯？

lines.en: : You probably shouldn’t try treating me like some fuckin’ doll to play dress up with! Should throw you over this fuckin’ ledge for trying.
lines.zh: : 你大概根本不该拿我当什么洋娃娃来玩换装游戏！就冲这个，真该把你从这该死的悬崖边扔下去。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Yumi. I just don’t like the idea of you being out in public naked and a crown atop your head would make me more comfortable.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Yumi。我只是不喜欢你光着身子待在户外，你头上戴顶冠我会安心些。

lines.en: : Well, I don’t give a shit about your {i}comfort,{/i} so offer something else or get the fuck out of here.
lines.zh: : 我他妈才不在乎你{i}安不安心{/i}，换个东西来，不然就给我滚出去。
: 呃……行吧。
薰衣草香水

lines.en: : How about some fragrant lavender perfume?
lines.zh: : 来点芬芳的薰衣草香水怎么样？
: 你去死怎么样？

lines.en: : I already tried that and you stopped me because you know you care about me deep down.
lines.zh: : 我试过了，是你拦住我的，因为你心里清楚你其实在乎我。

lines.en: : Nah, I just didn’t want you fuckin’ crash landing into somebody’s house and then having to deal with all the cops in the area and shit. Too many kids to rob and I don’t want ‘em snitching.
lines.zh: : 才不是，我只是不想看你他妈砸进别人家里，然后还得应付那一带所有的警察。我有的是小孩要抢，可不想让他们去告密。
: 你现在还干那个？

lines.en: : I {i}would{/i} if it weren’t for the lack of kids around these days. Guessin’ you already took ‘em all and chained ‘em up in your house, though.
lines.zh: : 要不是现在周遭没小孩了，我{i}当然{/i}还干。不过我猜你早就把他们全抓走，锁在你家了吧。

lines.en: : I don’t have time to kidnap anyone right now. I’m too busy trying to rebuild Maya.
lines.zh: : 我现在没空绑架谁。我忙着重建 Maya。

lines.en: : Well, you should try a little fuckin’ harder then. Because you ain’t gettin’ shit from me at this rate.
lines.zh: : 那你就他妈再努力点。照这个速度，你从我这儿什么都拿不到。

lines.en: Damn it. This girl is so mean.
lines.zh: 该死。这丫头真刻薄。
鸦片
: 我有……鸦片？
: 鸦片？
: 对。就是……毒品。

lines.en: : I know what fucking {i}opium{/i} is, dumbass. Why the hell do {i}you{/i} have it, though? You ain’t cool enough for that shit.
lines.zh: : 我他妈知道{i}鸦片{/i}是什么，蠢货。问题是{i}你{/i}怎么会有这东西？你还没那么酷。

lines.en: : I didn’t really know what else to do with the poppies I grew. And I figured that {i}someone{/i} would be willing to pay for this.
lines.zh: : 我种出来的罂粟，实在不知道还能拿来做点别的什么。而且我觉得{i}总有人{/i}愿意为这东西付钱。

lines.en: : I just didn’t think it would be the girl whose life had already been ravaged by drugs.
lines.zh: : 我只是没想到会是个人生早就被毒品毁过一次的女孩。

lines.en: : Course you didn’t, cause you’ve got no fuckin’ clue what you’re doing. It’s people specifically like {i}me{/i} who give into that shit and fall into the same goddamn hole they grew up in.
lines.zh: : 你当然没想到，因为你他妈根本不知道自己在干什么。就是「{i}我{/i}」这种人才会向那东西低头，掉回自己从小长大的那个该死的坑里。

lines.en: : But you’re better than that now, right?
lines.zh: : 但你现在已经不一样了，对吧？
: 没有。给我，混蛋。

lines.en: Yumi snatches the opium from me and swallows it the same way she swallowed a piece of Maya earlier.
lines.zh: Yumi 一把夺过鸦片，像先前吞下那块 Maya 一样吞了下去。

lines.en: : Now {i}THAT{/i} is what I’m fuckin’ talking about! {i}THAT{/i} is a god damn trade.
lines.zh: : 这{i}才{/i}对！这{i}才{/i}他妈是笔像样的交易。
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的躯干{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的骨盆{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右臂{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的左腿{b}!{/i}
{i}Sensei 获得了{b}Maya 的右腿{b}!{/i}

lines.en: : Will just swallowing it like that even get you high, though?...
lines.zh: : 可就这么直接吞下去，真的能嗨吗？……

lines.en: : You think I don’t know what I’m fuckin’ doing, numnuts?! I’m the goddamn {i}OPIUM QUEEN{/i} of the older district.
lines.zh: : 你以为老子不知道自己在干什么吗，蠢货？！我可是旧城区的{i}鸦片女王{/i}。

lines.en: : You get more of this shit, you bring it directly to me. You understand?
lines.zh: : 这东西你再弄到手，直接拿来找我。听懂了吗？

lines.en: : Why, though? I already got your Maya fragment.
lines.zh: : 为什么？我已经拿到你那块 Maya 了。

lines.en: : Because if you {i}don’t,{/i} I will find you and fucking {i}gut{/i} you.
lines.zh: : 因为你要是{i}不{/i}拿来，我就找到你，把你他妈开膛破肚。

lines.en: : You {i}really{/i} want something in exchange, I’ll just suck you off or whatever.
lines.zh: : 你{i}真{/i}想要点回报的话，我给你口就行，随便。

lines.en: : I’m not sure I want that. Your throat seems to be a bit of an abyss given the things I’ve watched you both swallow and regurgitate up here.
lines.zh: : 我可不确定我想要。看你在上面又吞又吐的那些东西，你的喉咙简直像个无底洞。

lines.en: : Ain’t that kind of a selling point, though?
lines.zh: : 那不正是卖点吗？

lines.en: : Not if you puke on me...
lines.zh: : 要是你吐我身上就不算……

lines.en: : Jesus Christ, you’re such a little bitch! Just take your god damn body part and get out of here!
lines.zh: : 天啊，你真是个小娘炮！拿着你那该死的身体部件滚出去！

lines.en: : Okay, Yumi...Thanks for your help. Even if it was mostly self-motivated and toxic.
lines.zh: : 好的，Yumi……谢谢你的帮忙。就算这帮忙多半是出于私心、还带着毒。

lines.en: : And thank {i}you{/i} for the drugs! I’m gonna be high as FUCK soon.
lines.zh: : 也谢谢「{i}你{/i}」的药！我马上就要嗨到飞起了。

lines.en: I leave Yumi and head back outside to figure out where to go from here.
lines.zh: 我离开 Yumi 回到外面，想想接下来该去哪儿。

lines.en: I can hear her excitedly shouting from half a mile away.
lines.zh: 半英里外都能听见她兴奋的叫喊。
玫瑰束

lines.en: : How about this nice bouquet of roses to-
lines.zh: : 这束漂亮的玫瑰怎么——

lines.en: Yumi snatches the bouquet out of my hands and throws it over the ledge.
lines.zh: Yumi 一把夺过花束，扔下了悬崖。

lines.en: : Yumi, what the heck? I worked hard on that.
lines.zh: : Yumi，你搞什么？我费了好大劲才做出来的。

lines.en: : And now you can work hard on goin’ to get it, fucker.
lines.zh: : 那你现在就费点劲下去捡啊，混蛋。
: 呃……等等。

lines.en: I dash down to the lower level of the street and retrieve the bouquet I made.
lines.zh: 我冲下街区的下一层，捡回我做的那束花。
那婊子{i}又{/i}「来了一遍」！

lines.en: : This is so unfair! Why are you so much faster than me in this dimension?
lines.zh: : 太不公平了！在这个次元里你为什么比我快这么多？

lines.en: : Beats me. Why are {i}you{/i} such a little bitch?
lines.zh: : 谁知道。倒是{i}你{/i}怎么就这么「娘」？

lines.en: I guess roses are a no-go...
lines.zh: 看来玫瑰是不行了……

lines.en: I head back down to the lower level to retrieve the bouquet again, tucking it safely back into my pocket before returning to Yumi...
lines.zh: 我又下到下一层把花束捡回来，稳妥地塞回口袋，然后回到 Yumi 身边……

lines.en: : That’ll teach you to keep all that {i}pretty{/i} shit away from me, fuckface.
lines.zh: : 这下你该学会别把那些{i}花里胡哨{/i}的东西往我跟前凑了，蠢脸。

lines.en: : Either make me a real offer or beat it.
lines.zh: : 要么给个像样的报价，要么滚蛋。
金鱼草手链

lines.en: : How about this snapdragon bracelet? I made it out of those seeds you vomited up and threw at me the first time I came here.
lines.zh: : 这条金鱼草手链怎么样？是用你第一次在这儿吐出来、还扔我身上的那些种子做的。

lines.en: : Oh, great. So now it’s even {i}bigger{/i} and I’ll have to puke it up again. You don’t think this shit through at all, do you?
lines.zh: : 哦，好极了。那它现在「{i}更大{/i}」了，我还得再吐一次。你做事从来不过脑子，是吧？

lines.en: : Not really. I’m kind of just guessing.
lines.zh: : 确实不太过。我基本就是在瞎猜。

lines.en: : Well, I’ll tell you what. Either you start guessing {i}better,{/i} or I’m going to divide my piece of Maya up into even {i}more{/i} pieces and make this puzzle {i}really{/i} fucking tough for you.
lines.zh: : 那我告诉你。要么你{i}猜{/i}得更准点，要么我就把这块 Maya 再切得{i}更碎{/i}，让这场拼图{i}真正{/i}他妈难为你。
: 听懂了吗，混蛋？
: 是，Yumi……我听懂了。

lines.en: : You gonna be a good boy?
lines.zh: : 你会做个好孩子吗？
: 我会做个好孩子……

lines.en: : You gonna get on your knees and bark like a little doggy?
lines.zh: : 那你要不要跪下来，像条小狗一样叫两声？
: 我真的不想……

lines.en: : Do it or I’ll fucking kill you.
lines.zh: : 叫，不然我他妈杀了你。

lines.en: I get on my knees and bark like a little doggy.
lines.zh: 我跪下来，像条小狗一样叫了两声。

lines.en: This is a new low for me.
lines.zh: 这对我来说是个新的下限。
: 很好……

lines.en: : Now rise and make me a new offer.
lines.zh: : 现在起来，给我个新的报价。
: 呃……我看看……
回到外面

lines.en: : Actually, I think I’ll just come back another time. It seems like you’re in a bad mood.
lines.zh: : 其实我想还是改天再来吧。你看起来心情不太好。

lines.en: : The fuck would give you that idea, douche-monkey?
lines.zh: : 你他妈从哪儿看出来的，蠢猴子？
: 就那句。对不起，Yumi。

lines.en: : Good. Fuckin’ go then. See if I care.
lines.zh: : 很好。那你他妈滚吧。我才不在乎呢。

lines.en: I head back outside and try to figure out where to go from here.
lines.zh: 我回到外面，试着想想接下来该去哪儿。
现在怎么办？

lines.en: Slowly and methodically, I begin to fuse all of Maya’s pieces back together by mixing my saliva with a jar of fleshglue.
lines.zh: 我把唾液和一罐肉胶混在一起，开始缓慢而细致地把 Maya 的所有部件粘合回去。

lines.en: It’s a long and arduous process that culminates in my bed becoming a sopping wet mess of bodily fluids, but I manage to do it without sacrificing most of her organs.
lines.zh: 这是个漫长又煎熬的过程，最后把我的床弄成了一片体液狼藉的湿透模样，但我总算做到了，而且没有牺牲掉她大部分的器官。

lines.en: There are a few I need to take out as they don’t agree with the fleshglue, but I preserve them in a series of large jars provided by Horseface Taki in the event that Maya wants them back one day.
lines.zh: 有几个器官和肉胶不合，我不得不取出来，不过我用 Horseface Taki 提供的一系列大罐子把它们保存起来，以备 Maya 哪天想要回去。
: 操，太爽了！

lines.en: : You’ve done it, Akira Arakawa! You’ve completed another reset puzzle by reassembling your lost love!
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 你做到了，Akira Arakawa！你又一次完成重置拼图，把你失去的爱人重新拼了回来！

lines.en: : Do you have anything you’d like to say to the viewers back home?
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 你有什么想对家里的观众说的吗？

lines.en: : I’m just glad I didn’t have to do this with Sekai. There were {i}way{/i} more pieces of her when she died.
lines.zh: : 我只是庆幸这次不用对 Sekai 做这种事。她死的时候部件{i}多{/i}得多。

lines.en: : Plus, Maya being freshly deceased once the puzzle began let me finish everything before she went cold.
lines.zh: : 而且 Maya 是拼图开始时才刚死不久，我能在她变冷之前把一切都弄完。

lines.en: : It was a pretty smooth experience, I’ve gotta say. And I wouldn’t have been able to do it without the support of my fans.
lines.zh: : 说真的，整个过程相当顺利。没有粉丝们的支持，我可做不到。

lines.en: : And what would you say is in store for those fans, {i}next?{/i} Where will Akira Arakawa go from here?
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 那你能透露一下，那些粉丝「{i}接下来{/i}」会看到什么吗？Akira Arakawa 之后会走向何方？

lines.en: : Well, Horseface Taki — the {i}first{/i} thing I’m going to do is get this body back home and give my daughter a stern lecturing about proper beach conduct.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Horseface Taki——我{i}第一{/i}件要做的事，就是把这具身体带回家，好好训斥我女儿一顿，教教她海滩上的规矩。

lines.en: : {i}Then,{/i} I think I’ll probably kick back and relax with a nice warm cup of Joseph. And hey, if I’m feeling crazy, I might even call my ex and apologize to her for fucking her little sister.
lines.zh: : {i}然后{/i}，我想我大概会靠在椅背上，用一杯温热的 Joseph 放松一下。嘿，要是我发了疯，说不定还会给我前任打个电话，为睡了她妹妹道个歉。

lines.en: : Wow! So it seems like you’re {i}really{/i} trying to put a positive spin on your life following the completion of this mission. Is that true?
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 哇！所以看来你打算在任务完成之后{i}真正{/i}积极地面对生活了。是这样吗？

lines.en: : It sure is, Horseface Taki. No more mistakes for me. I’m a changed man now that I have made death my little cumslut.
lines.zh: : 当然了，Horseface Taki。我不会再犯错了。既然我已经把死亡变成了我的小精奴，我现在就是个脱胎换骨的人了。

lines.en: : You heard it here first, folks! Akira Arakawa has every intention of turning his life around! But is it perhaps {i}too late{/i} for that given the {i}state{/i} of his world?
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 独家消息，各位！Akira Arakawa 下定决心要改过自新！但考虑到他那个世界的{i}现状{/i}，会不会已经{i}太迟{/i}了呢？
: 什么？

lines.en: : {size=-1}In just a few short moments, Akira Arakawa will learn that the events he experienced prior to our program are actually {i}irreversible!{/i} And I can assure you that you won’t want to miss {i}that!{/i}{/size}
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: {size=-1}再过短短片刻，Akira Arakawa 就会得知，他在我们节目之前所经历的那些事其实是「不可逆的」！我敢保证，你绝对不会想错过「那一幕」！{/size}

lines.en: : Wha- irreversible? But that’s...No. That’s not how this is supposed to work. Reset puzzles always end with things going back to normal and-
lines.zh: : 什么——不可逆？可那是……不。事情不该是这样的。重置拼图总是以一切恢复正常收尾，而且——

lines.en: : Unfortunately, that’s all the time we have for today! But-
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 遗憾的是，今天的时间就到这里了！不过——

lines.en: : No it’s not! There’s plenty more time! What do you mean “that’s all?!”
lines.zh: : 不对，还有的是时间！你说「就到这里」是什么意思？！

lines.en: : ...But join us next time for an all new reunion episode where we bring two fan-favorite girls back to the house of their dreams!
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : ……不过敬请期待下一期全新的重聚特辑，我们要把两位人气最高的女孩带回她们梦中的家！
: 别说了！我还没说完！

lines.en: : {i}I’m{/i} Horseface Taki. And {i}you’re{/i} watching HBTV. See you next time!
lines.spk: Horseface Taki, God of the Track
lines.zh: : 「{i}我{/i}」是 Horseface Taki。而「{i}你{/i}」正在收看 HBTV。下期再见！

lines.en: I return to the UNBLEACHED BEACH and call out to Sana for help, but she is not here.
lines.zh: 我回到未漂白海滩，呼喊 Sana 求助，可她不在这儿。

lines.en: In her place stands an unrecognizable mass of flesh, slowly gurgling and pulsating with boils and growths of various sizes as the corpsecrown sits atop what looks like the remnants of a head.
lines.zh: 站在那儿的是一团辨认不出的肉块，随着大小不一的脓包和增生缓缓起伏、咕噜作响，那顶尸冠就扣在一个看起来像是头部残骸的东西上。

lines.en: This is clearly not important right now. I have a fish to save.
lines.zh: 这显然眼下不重要。我还有条鱼要救。

lines.en: I remove it from my pocket and make a mad dash to the water, pleading for it to hold on for at least one more minute.
lines.zh: 我把它从口袋里取出来，发疯似的冲向水边，求它至少再撑一分钟。
而它撑住了。

lines.en: And I drop it into the water.
lines.zh: 我把它放进水里。

lines.en: It looks up at me, thankful.
lines.zh: 它抬头看我，带着谢意。

lines.en: I stare back, fulfilled — but empty.
lines.zh: 我回望它，心满意足——却空空荡荡。
我跟着跳了进去。
我属于这片海。
